@@ -0,0 +1,348 @@
+.. highlight:: python
+
+.. _html-themes:
+
+HTML Theming
+============
+
+Sphinx provides a number of builders for HTML and HTML-based formats.
+
+Builders
+--------
+
+.. todo:: Populate when the 'builders' document is split up.
+
+
+Themes
+------
+
+.. versionadded:: 0.6
+
+.. note::
+
+   This section provides information about using pre-existing HTML themes. If
+   you wish to create your own theme, refer to
+   :doc:`/development/theming`.
+
+Sphinx supports changing the appearance of its HTML output via *themes*.  A
+theme is a collection of HTML templates, stylesheet(s) and other static files.
+Additionally, it has a configuration file which specifies from which theme to
+inherit, which highlighting style to use, and what options exist for customizing
+the theme's look and feel.
+
+Themes are meant to be project-unaware, so they can be used for different
+projects without change.
+
+Using a theme
+~~~~~~~~~~~~~
+
+Using a :ref:`theme provided with Sphinx <builtin-themes>` is easy. Since these
+do not need to be installed, you only need to set the :confval:`html_theme`
+config value. For example, to enable the ``classic`` theme, add the following
+to :file:`conf.py`::
+
+    html_theme = "classic"
+
+You can also set theme-specific options using the :confval:`html_theme_options`
+config value.  These options are generally used to change the look and feel of
+the theme. For example, to place the sidebar on the right side and a black
+background for the relation bar (the bar with the navigation links at the
+page's top and bottom), add the following :file:`conf.py`::
+
+    html_theme_options = {
+        "rightsidebar": "true",
+        "relbarbgcolor": "black"
+    }
+
+If the theme does not come with Sphinx, it can be in two static forms or as a
+Python package. For the static forms, either a directory (containing
+:file:`theme.conf` and other needed files), or a zip file with the same
+contents is supported. The directory or zipfile must be put where Sphinx can
+find it; for this there is the config value :confval:`html_theme_path`. This
+can be a list of directories, relative to the directory containing
+:file:`conf.py`, that can contain theme directories or zip files.  For example,
+if you have a theme in the file :file:`blue.zip`, you can put it right in the
+directory containing :file:`conf.py` and use this configuration::
+
+    html_theme = "blue"
+    html_theme_path = ["."]
+
+The third form is a Python package.  If a theme you want to use is distributed
+as a Python package, you can use it after installing
+
+.. code-block:: bash
+
+    # installing theme package
+    $ pip install sphinxjp.themes.dotted
+
+Once installed, this can be used in the same manner as a directory or
+zipfile-based theme::
+
+    html_theme = "dotted"
+
+For more information on the design of themes, including information about
+writing your own themes, refer to :doc:`/development/theming`.
+

+Sphinx comes with a selection of themes to choose from.
+
+.. cssclass:: clear
+
+These themes are:
+
+**basic**
+  This is a basically unstyled layout used as the base for the
+  other themes, and usable as the base for custom themes as well.  The HTML
+  contains all important elements like sidebar and relation bar.  There are
+  these options (which are inherited by the other themes):
+
+  - **nosidebar** (true or false): Don't include the sidebar.  Defaults to
+    ``False``.
+
+  - **sidebarwidth** (int or str): Width of the sidebar in pixels.
+    This can be an int, which is interpreted as pixels or a valid CSS
+    dimension string such as '70em' or '50%'.  Defaults to 230 pixels.
+
+  - **body_min_width** (int or str): Minimal width of the document body.
+    This can be an int, which is interpreted as pixels or a valid CSS
+    dimension string such as '70em' or '50%'. Use 0 if you don't want
+    a width limit. Defaults may depend on the theme (often 450px).
+
+  - **body_max_width** (int or str): Maximal width of the document body.
+    This can be an int, which is interpreted as pixels or a valid CSS
+    dimension string such as '70em' or '50%'. Use 'none' if you don't
+    want a width limit. Defaults may depend on the theme (often 800px).
+
+  - **navigation_with_keys** (true or false): Allow navigating to the
+    previous/next page using the keyboard's left and right arrows.  Defaults to
+    ``False``.
+
+  - **globaltoc_collapse** (true or false): Only expand subsections
+    of the current document in ``globaltoc.html``
+    (see :confval:`html_sidebars`).
+    Defaults to ``True``.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 3.1
+
+  - **globaltoc_includehidden** (true or false): Show even those
+    subsections in ``globaltoc.html`` (see :confval:`html_sidebars`)
+    which have been included with the ``:hidden:`` flag of the
+    :rst:dir:`toctree` directive.
+    Defaults to ``False``.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 3.1
+
+  - **globaltoc_maxdepth** (int): The maximum depth of the toctree in
+    ``globaltoc.html`` (see :confval:`html_sidebars`).  Set it to -1 to allow
+    unlimited depth. Defaults to the max depth selected in the toctree directive.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 3.2
+
+**alabaster**
+  `Alabaster theme`_ is a modified "Kr" Sphinx theme from @kennethreitz
+  (especially as used in his Requests project), which was itself originally
+  based on @mitsuhiko's theme used for Flask & related projects.  Refer to its
+  `installation page`_ for information on how to configure
+  :confval:`html_sidebars` for its use.
+
+  .. _Alabaster theme: https://pypi.org/project/alabaster/
+  .. _installation page: https://alabaster.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html
+
+**classic**
+  This is the classic theme, which looks like `the Python 2
+  documentation <https://docs.python.org/2/>`_.  It can be customized via
+  these options:
+
+  - **rightsidebar** (true or false): Put the sidebar on the right side.
+    Defaults to ``False``.
+
+  - **stickysidebar** (true or false): Make the sidebar "fixed" so that it
+    doesn't scroll out of view for long body content.  This may not work well
+    with all browsers.  Defaults to ``False``.
+
+  - **collapsiblesidebar** (true or false): Add an *experimental* JavaScript
+    snippet that makes the sidebar collapsible via a button on its side.
+    Defaults to ``False``.
+
+  - **externalrefs** (true or false): Display external links differently from
+    internal links.  Defaults to ``False``.
+
+  There are also various color and font options that can change the color scheme
+  without having to write a custom stylesheet:
+
+  - **footerbgcolor** (CSS color): Background color for the footer line.
+  - **footertextcolor** (CSS color): Text color for the footer line.
+  - **sidebarbgcolor** (CSS color): Background color for the sidebar.
+  - **sidebarbtncolor** (CSS color): Background color for the sidebar collapse
+    button (used when *collapsiblesidebar* is ``True``).
+  - **sidebartextcolor** (CSS color): Text color for the sidebar.
+  - **sidebarlinkcolor** (CSS color): Link color for the sidebar.
+  - **relbarbgcolor** (CSS color): Background color for the relation bar.
+  - **relbartextcolor** (CSS color): Text color for the relation bar.
+  - **relbarlinkcolor** (CSS color): Link color for the relation bar.
+  - **bgcolor** (CSS color): Body background color.
+  - **textcolor** (CSS color): Body text color.
+  - **linkcolor** (CSS color): Body link color.
+  - **visitedlinkcolor** (CSS color): Body color for visited links.
+  - **headbgcolor** (CSS color): Background color for headings.
+  - **headtextcolor** (CSS color): Text color for headings.
+  - **headlinkcolor** (CSS color): Link color for headings.
+  - **codebgcolor** (CSS color): Background color for code blocks.
+  - **codetextcolor** (CSS color): Default text color for code blocks, if not
+    set differently by the highlighting style.
+
+  - **bodyfont** (CSS font-family): Font for normal text.
+  - **headfont** (CSS font-family): Font for headings.
+
+**sphinxdoc**
+  The theme originally used by this documentation. It features
+  a sidebar on the right side. There are currently no options beyond
+  *nosidebar* and *sidebarwidth*.
+
+  .. note::
+
+    The Sphinx documentation now uses
+    `an adjusted version of the sphinxdoc theme
+    <https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx/tree/master/doc/_themes/sphinx13>`_.
+
+**scrolls**
+  A more lightweight theme, based on `the Jinja documentation
+  <https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/>`_.  The following color options are available:
+
+  - **headerbordercolor**
+  - **subheadlinecolor**
+  - **linkcolor**
+  - **visitedlinkcolor**
+  - **admonitioncolor**
+
+**agogo**
+  A theme created by Andi Albrecht.  The following options are supported:
+
+  - **bodyfont** (CSS font family): Font for normal text.
+  - **headerfont** (CSS font family): Font for headings.
+  - **pagewidth** (CSS length): Width of the page content, default 70em.
+  - **documentwidth** (CSS length): Width of the document (without sidebar),
+    default 50em.
+  - **sidebarwidth** (CSS length): Width of the sidebar, default 20em.
+  - **rightsidebar** (true or false): Put the sidebar on the right side.
+    Defaults to ``True``.
+  - **bgcolor** (CSS color): Background color.
+  - **headerbg** (CSS value for "background"): background for the header area,
+    default a grayish gradient.
+  - **footerbg** (CSS value for "background"): background for the footer area,
+    default a light gray gradient.
+  - **linkcolor** (CSS color): Body link color.
+  - **headercolor1**, **headercolor2** (CSS color): colors for <h1> and <h2>
+    headings.
+  - **headerlinkcolor** (CSS color): Color for the backreference link in
+    headings.
+  - **textalign** (CSS *text-align* value): Text alignment for the body, default
+    is ``justify``.
+
+**nature**
+  A greenish theme.  There are currently no options beyond
+  *nosidebar* and *sidebarwidth*.
+
+**pyramid**
+  A theme from the Pyramid web framework project, designed by Blaise Laflamme.
+  There are currently no options beyond *nosidebar* and *sidebarwidth*.
+
+**haiku**
+  A theme without sidebar inspired by the `Haiku OS user guide
+  <https://www.haiku-os.org/docs/userguide/en/contents.html>`_.  The following
+  options are supported:
+
+  - **full_logo** (true or false, default ``False``): If this is true, the
+    header will only show the :confval:`html_logo`.  Use this for large logos.
+    If this is false, the logo (if present) will be shown floating right, and
+    the documentation title will be put in the header.
+
+  - **textcolor**, **headingcolor**, **linkcolor**, **visitedlinkcolor**,
+    **hoverlinkcolor** (CSS colors): Colors for various body elements.
+
+**traditional**
+  A theme resembling the old Python documentation.  There are
+  currently no options beyond *nosidebar* and *sidebarwidth*.
+
+**epub**
+  A theme for the epub builder.  This theme tries to save visual
+  space which is a sparse resource on ebook readers.  The following options
+  are supported:
+
+  - **relbar1** (true or false, default ``True``): If this is true, the
+    `relbar1` block is inserted in the epub output, otherwise it is omitted.
+
+  - **footer**  (true or false, default ``True``): If this is true, the
+    `footer` block is inserted in the epub output, otherwise it is omitted.
+
+**bizstyle**
+  A simple bluish theme. The following options are supported
+  beyond *nosidebar* and *sidebarwidth*:
+
+  - **rightsidebar** (true or false): Put the sidebar on the right side.
+    Defaults to ``False``.
+
+.. versionadded:: 1.3
+   'alabaster', 'sphinx_rtd_theme' and 'bizstyle' theme.
+
+.. versionchanged:: 1.3
+   The 'default' theme has been renamed to 'classic'. 'default' is still
+   available, however it will emit a notice that it is an alias for the new
+   'alabaster' theme.
+
+Third Party Themes
+~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
+
+There are many third-party themes available for Sphinx. Some of these are for
+general use, while others are specific to an individual project.
+
+sphinx-themes.org__ is a gallery that showcases various themes for Sphinx,
+with demo documentation rendered under each theme. Themes can also be found
+on PyPI__ (using the classifier ``Framework :: Sphinx :: Theme``), GitHub__
+and GitLab__.
+

+.. __: https://github.com/search?utf8=%E2%9C%93&q=sphinx+theme

+The basic Sphinx documentation for testing
+==========================================
+
+Sphinx is a tool that makes it easy to create intelligent and beautiful
+documentation for Python projects (or other documents consisting of multiple
+reStructuredText sources), written by Georg Brandl.  It was originally created
+for the new Python documentation, and has excellent facilities for Python
+project documentation, but C/C++ is supported as well, and more languages are
+planned.
+
+Sphinx uses reStructuredText as its markup language, and many of its strengths
+come from the power and straightforwardness of reStructuredText and its parsing
+and translating suite, the Docutils.
+
+features
+--------
+
+Among its features are the following:
+
+* Output formats: HTML (including derivative formats such as HTML Help, Epub
+  and Qt Help), plain text, manual pages and LaTeX or direct PDF output
+  using rst2pdf
+* Extensive cross-references: semantic markup and automatic links
+  for functions, classes, glossary terms and similar pieces of information
+* Hierarchical structure: easy definition of a document tree, with automatic
+  links to siblings, parents and children
+* Automatic indices: general index as well as a module index
+* Code handling: automatic highlighting using the Pygments highlighter
+* Flexible HTML output using the Jinja 2 templating engine
+* Various extensions are available, e.g. for automatic testing of snippets

+Testing object descriptions
+===========================
+
+.. function:: func_without_module(a, b, *c[, d])
+
+   Does something.
+
+.. function:: func_without_body()
+
+.. function:: func_noindex
+   :noindex:
+
+.. function:: func_with_module
+   :module: foolib
+
+Referring to :func:`func with no index <func_noindex>`.
+Referring to :func:`nothing <>`.
+
+.. module:: mod
+   :synopsis: Module synopsis.
+   :platform: UNIX
+
+.. function:: func_in_module
+
+.. class:: Cls
+
+   .. method:: meth1
+
+   .. staticmethod:: meths
+
+   .. attribute:: attr
+
+.. explicit class given
+.. method:: Cls.meth2
+
+.. explicit module given
+.. exception:: Error(arg1, arg2)
+   :module: errmod
+
+.. data:: var
+
+
+.. currentmodule:: None
+
+.. function:: func_without_module2() -> annotation
+
+.. object:: long(parameter, \
+              list)
+            another one
+
+.. class:: TimeInt
+
+   Has only one parameter (triggers special behavior...)
+
+   :param moo: |test|
+   :type moo: |test|
+
+.. |test| replace:: Moo
+
+.. class:: Time(hour, minute, isdst)
+
+   :param year: The year.
+   :type year: TimeInt
+   :param TimeInt minute: The minute.
+   :param isdst: whether it's DST
+   :type isdst: * some complex
+                * expression
+   :returns: a new :class:`Time` instance
+   :rtype: :class:`Time`
+   :raises ValueError: if the values are out of range
+   :ivar int hour: like *hour*
+   :ivar minute: like *minute*
+   :vartype minute: int
+   :param hour: Some parameter
+   :type hour: DuplicateType
+   :param hour: Duplicate param.  Should not lead to crashes.
+   :type hour: DuplicateType
+   :param .Cls extcls: A class from another module.
+
+
+C items
+=======
+
+.. c:function:: Sphinx_DoSomething()
+
+.. c:member:: SphinxStruct.member
+
+.. c:macro:: SPHINX_USE_PYTHON
+
+.. c:type:: SphinxType
+
+.. c:var:: sphinx_global
+
+
+Javascript items
+================
+
+.. js:function:: foo()
+
+.. js:data:: bar
+
+.. documenting the method of any object
+.. js:function:: bar.baz(href, callback[, errback])
+
+   :param string href: The location of the resource.
+   :param callback: Get's called with the data returned by the resource.
+   :throws InvalidHref: If the `href` is invalid.
+   :returns: `undefined`
+
+.. js:attribute:: bar.spam
+
+References
+==========
+
+Referencing :class:`mod.Cls` or :Class:`mod.Cls` should be the same.
+
+With target: :c:func:`Sphinx_DoSomething()` (parentheses are handled),
+:c:member:`SphinxStruct.member`, :c:macro:`SPHINX_USE_PYTHON`,
+:c:type:`SphinxType *` (pointer is handled), :c:data:`sphinx_global`.
+
+Without target: :c:func:`CFunction`. :c:func:`!malloc`.
+
+:js:func:`foo()`
+:js:func:`foo`
+
+:js:data:`bar`
+:js:func:`bar.baz()`
+:js:func:`bar.baz`
+:js:func:`~bar.baz()`
+
+:js:attr:`bar.baz`
+
+
+Others
+======
+
+.. envvar:: HOME
+
+.. program:: python
+
+.. cmdoption:: -c command
+
+.. program:: perl
+
+.. cmdoption:: -c
+
+.. option:: +p
+
+Link to :option:`perl +p`.
+
+
+User markup
+===========
+
+.. userdesc:: myobj:parameter
+
+   Description of userdesc.
+
+
+Referencing :userdescrole:`myobj`.
+
+
+CPP domain
+==========
+

+
+   .. cpp:function:: T& operator[]( unsigned j )
+                     const T& operator[]( unsigned j ) const

+if (!Scorer) {

+   * Simple result scoring code.

+  var Scorer = {
+    // Implement the following function to further tweak the score for each result
+    // The function takes a result array [filename, title, anchor, descr, score]
+    // and returns the new score.
+    /*
+    score: function(result) {
+      return result[4];
+    },
+    */
+
+    // query matches the full name of an object
+    objNameMatch: 11,
+    // or matches in the last dotted part of the object name
+    objPartialMatch: 6,
+    // Additive scores depending on the priority of the object
+    objPrio: {0:  15,   // used to be importantResults

+    //  Used when the priority is not in the mapping.

+
+    // query found in title

+    partialTitle: 7,
+    // query found in terms

+    partialTerm: 2
+  };
+}
+

+  function splitQuery(query) {
+    return query.split(/\s+/);
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Search Module
+ */
+var Search = {
+
+  _index : null,
+  _queued_query : null,
+  _pulse_status : -1,
+
+  htmlToText : function(htmlString) {

+      docContent = htmlElement.find('[role=main]')[0];

+          return "";
+      }

+  },
+
+  init : function() {
+      var params = $.getQueryParameters();
+      if (params.q) {
+          var query = params.q[0];
+          $('input[name="q"]')[0].value = query;
+          this.performSearch(query);
+      }
+  },
+
+  loadIndex : function(url) {
+    $.ajax({type: "GET", url: url, data: null,
+            dataType: "script", cache: true,
+            complete: function(jqxhr, textstatus) {
+              if (textstatus != "success") {
+                document.getElementById("searchindexloader").src = url;
+              }
+            }});
+  },
+
+  setIndex : function(index) {
+    var q;
+    this._index = index;
+    if ((q = this._queued_query) !== null) {
+      this._queued_query = null;
+      Search.query(q);
+    }
+  },
+
+  hasIndex : function() {
+      return this._index !== null;
+  },
+
+  deferQuery : function(query) {
+      this._queued_query = query;
+  },
+
+  stopPulse : function() {
+      this._pulse_status = 0;
+  },
+
+  startPulse : function() {
+    if (this._pulse_status >= 0)
+        return;
+    function pulse() {
+      var i;
+      Search._pulse_status = (Search._pulse_status + 1) % 4;
+      var dotString = '';
+      for (i = 0; i < Search._pulse_status; i++)
+        dotString += '.';
+      Search.dots.text(dotString);
+      if (Search._pulse_status > -1)
+        window.setTimeout(pulse, 500);
+    }
+    pulse();
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * perform a search for something (or wait until index is loaded)
+   */
+  performSearch : function(query) {
+    // create the required interface elements
+    this.out = $('#search-results');
+    this.title = $('<h2>' + _('Searching') + '</h2>').appendTo(this.out);
+    this.dots = $('<span></span>').appendTo(this.title);
+    this.status = $('<p class="search-summary"> </p>').appendTo(this.out);
+    this.output = $('<ul class="search"/>').appendTo(this.out);
+
+    $('#search-progress').text(_('Preparing search...'));
+    this.startPulse();
+
+    // index already loaded, the browser was quick!
+    if (this.hasIndex())
+      this.query(query);
+    else
+      this.deferQuery(query);
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * execute search (requires search index to be loaded)
+   */
+  query : function(query) {
+    var i;
+
+    // stem the searchterms and add them to the correct list
+    var stemmer = new Stemmer();
+    var searchterms = [];
+    var excluded = [];
+    var hlterms = [];
+    var tmp = splitQuery(query);
+    var objectterms = [];
+    for (i = 0; i < tmp.length; i++) {
+      if (tmp[i] !== "") {
+          objectterms.push(tmp[i].toLowerCase());
+      }
+
+      if ($u.indexOf(stopwords, tmp[i].toLowerCase()) != -1 || tmp[i] === "") {
+        // skip this "word"
+        continue;
+      }
+      // stem the word
+      var word = stemmer.stemWord(tmp[i].toLowerCase());
+      // prevent stemmer from cutting word smaller than two chars
+      if(word.length < 3 && tmp[i].length >= 3) {
+        word = tmp[i];
+      }
+      var toAppend;
+      // select the correct list
+      if (word[0] == '-') {
+        toAppend = excluded;
+        word = word.substr(1);
+      }
+      else {
+        toAppend = searchterms;
+        hlterms.push(tmp[i].toLowerCase());
+      }
+      // only add if not already in the list
+      if (!$u.contains(toAppend, word))
+        toAppend.push(word);
+    }
+    var highlightstring = '?highlight=' + $.urlencode(hlterms.join(" "));
+
+    // console.debug('SEARCH: searching for:');
+    // console.info('required: ', searchterms);
+    // console.info('excluded: ', excluded);
+
+    // prepare search
+    var terms = this._index.terms;
+    var titleterms = this._index.titleterms;
+
+    // array of [filename, title, anchor, descr, score]
+    var results = [];
+    $('#search-progress').empty();
+
+    // lookup as object
+    for (i = 0; i < objectterms.length; i++) {
+      var others = [].concat(objectterms.slice(0, i),
+                             objectterms.slice(i+1, objectterms.length));
+      results = results.concat(this.performObjectSearch(objectterms[i], others));
+    }
+
+    // lookup as search terms in fulltext
+    results = results.concat(this.performTermsSearch(searchterms, excluded, terms, titleterms));
+
+    // let the scorer override scores with a custom scoring function
+    if (Scorer.score) {
+      for (i = 0; i < results.length; i++)
+        results[i][4] = Scorer.score(results[i]);
+    }
+
+    // now sort the results by score (in opposite order of appearance, since the
+    // display function below uses pop() to retrieve items) and then
+    // alphabetically
+    results.sort(function(a, b) {
+      var left = a[4];
+      var right = b[4];
+      if (left > right) {
+        return 1;
+      } else if (left < right) {
+        return -1;
+      } else {
+        // same score: sort alphabetically
+        left = a[1].toLowerCase();
+        right = b[1].toLowerCase();
+        return (left > right) ? -1 : ((left < right) ? 1 : 0);
+      }
+    });
+
+    // for debugging
+    //Search.lastresults = results.slice();  // a copy
+    //console.info('search results:', Search.lastresults);
+
+    // print the results
+    var resultCount = results.length;
+    function displayNextItem() {
+      // results left, load the summary and display it
+      if (results.length) {
+        var item = results.pop();
+        var listItem = $('<li></li>');
+        var requestUrl = "";
+        var linkUrl = "";
+        if (DOCUMENTATION_OPTIONS.BUILDER === 'dirhtml') {
+          // dirhtml builder
+          var dirname = item[0] + '/';
+          if (dirname.match(/\/index\/$/)) {
+            dirname = dirname.substring(0, dirname.length-6);
+          } else if (dirname == 'index/') {
+            dirname = '';
+          }
+          requestUrl = DOCUMENTATION_OPTIONS.URL_ROOT + dirname;
+          linkUrl = requestUrl;
+
+        } else {
+          // normal html builders
+          requestUrl = DOCUMENTATION_OPTIONS.URL_ROOT + item[0] + DOCUMENTATION_OPTIONS.FILE_SUFFIX;
+          linkUrl = item[0] + DOCUMENTATION_OPTIONS.LINK_SUFFIX;
+        }
+        listItem.append($('<a/>').attr('href',
+            linkUrl +
+            highlightstring + item[2]).html(item[1]));
+        if (item[3]) {
+          listItem.append($('<span> (' + item[3] + ')</span>'));
+          Search.output.append(listItem);
+          setTimeout(function() {
+            displayNextItem();
+          }, 5);
+        } else {
+          $.ajax({url: requestUrl,
+                  dataType: "text",
+                  complete: function(jqxhr, textstatus) {
+                    var data = jqxhr.responseText;
+                    if (data !== '' && data !== undefined) {
+                      listItem.append(Search.makeSearchSummary(data, searchterms, hlterms));
+                    }
+                    Search.output.append(listItem);
+                    setTimeout(function() {
+                      displayNextItem();
+                    }, 5);
+                  }});
+        }
+      }
+      // search finished, update title and status message
+      else {
+        Search.stopPulse();
+        Search.title.text(_('Search Results'));
+        if (!resultCount)
+          Search.status.text(_('Your search did not match any documents. Please make sure that all words are spelled correctly and that you\'ve selected enough categories.'));
+        else
+            Search.status.text(_('Search finished, found %s page(s) matching the search query.').replace('%s', resultCount));
+        Search.status.fadeIn(500);
+      }
+    }
+    displayNextItem();
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * search for object names
+   */
+  performObjectSearch : function(object, otherterms) {
+    var filenames = this._index.filenames;
+    var docnames = this._index.docnames;
+    var objects = this._index.objects;
+    var objnames = this._index.objnames;
+    var titles = this._index.titles;
+
+    var i;
+    var results = [];
+
+    for (var prefix in objects) {
+      for (var name in objects[prefix]) {
+        var fullname = (prefix ? prefix + '.' : '') + name;
+        var fullnameLower = fullname.toLowerCase()
+        if (fullnameLower.indexOf(object) > -1) {
+          var score = 0;
+          var parts = fullnameLower.split('.');
+          // check for different match types: exact matches of full name or
+          // "last name" (i.e. last dotted part)
+          if (fullnameLower == object || parts[parts.length - 1] == object) {
+            score += Scorer.objNameMatch;
+          // matches in last name
+          } else if (parts[parts.length - 1].indexOf(object) > -1) {
+            score += Scorer.objPartialMatch;
+          }
+          var match = objects[prefix][name];
+          var objname = objnames[match[1]][2];
+          var title = titles[match[0]];
+          // If more than one term searched for, we require other words to be
+          // found in the name/title/description
+          if (otherterms.length > 0) {
+            var haystack = (prefix + ' ' + name + ' ' +
+                            objname + ' ' + title).toLowerCase();
+            var allfound = true;
+            for (i = 0; i < otherterms.length; i++) {
+              if (haystack.indexOf(otherterms[i]) == -1) {
+                allfound = false;
+                break;
+              }
+            }
+            if (!allfound) {
+              continue;
+            }
+          }
+          var descr = objname + _(', in ') + title;
+
+          var anchor = match[3];
+          if (anchor === '')
+            anchor = fullname;
+          else if (anchor == '-')
+            anchor = objnames[match[1]][1] + '-' + fullname;
+          // add custom score for some objects according to scorer
+          if (Scorer.objPrio.hasOwnProperty(match[2])) {
+            score += Scorer.objPrio[match[2]];
+          } else {
+            score += Scorer.objPrioDefault;
+          }
+          results.push([docnames[match[0]], fullname, '#'+anchor, descr, score, filenames[match[0]]]);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    return results;
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Regular_Expressions
+   */
+  escapeRegExp : function(string) {
+    return string.replace(/[.*+\-?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); // $& means the whole matched string
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * search for full-text terms in the index
+   */
+  performTermsSearch : function(searchterms, excluded, terms, titleterms) {
+    var docnames = this._index.docnames;
+    var filenames = this._index.filenames;
+    var titles = this._index.titles;
+
+    var i, j, file;
+    var fileMap = {};
+    var scoreMap = {};
+    var results = [];
+
+    // perform the search on the required terms
+    for (i = 0; i < searchterms.length; i++) {
+      var word = searchterms[i];
+      var files = [];
+      var _o = [
+        {files: terms[word], score: Scorer.term},
+        {files: titleterms[word], score: Scorer.title}
+      ];
+      // add support for partial matches
+      if (word.length > 2) {
+        var word_regex = this.escapeRegExp(word);
+        for (var w in terms) {
+          if (w.match(word_regex) && !terms[word]) {
+            _o.push({files: terms[w], score: Scorer.partialTerm})
+          }
+        }
+        for (var w in titleterms) {
+          if (w.match(word_regex) && !titleterms[word]) {
+              _o.push({files: titleterms[w], score: Scorer.partialTitle})
+          }
+        }
+      }
+
+      // no match but word was a required one
+      if ($u.every(_o, function(o){return o.files === undefined;})) {
+        break;
+      }
+      // found search word in contents
+      $u.each(_o, function(o) {
+        var _files = o.files;
+        if (_files === undefined)
+          return
+
+        if (_files.length === undefined)
+          _files = [_files];
+        files = files.concat(_files);
+
+        // set score for the word in each file to Scorer.term
+        for (j = 0; j < _files.length; j++) {
+          file = _files[j];
+          if (!(file in scoreMap))
+            scoreMap[file] = {};
+          scoreMap[file][word] = o.score;
+        }
+      });
+
+      // create the mapping
+      for (j = 0; j < files.length; j++) {
+        file = files[j];
+        if (file in fileMap && fileMap[file].indexOf(word) === -1)
+          fileMap[file].push(word);
+        else
+          fileMap[file] = [word];
+      }
+    }
+
+    // now check if the files don't contain excluded terms
+    for (file in fileMap) {
+      var valid = true;
+
+      // check if all requirements are matched
+      var filteredTermCount = // as search terms with length < 3 are discarded: ignore
+        searchterms.filter(function(term){return term.length > 2}).length
+      if (
+        fileMap[file].length != searchterms.length &&
+        fileMap[file].length != filteredTermCount
+      ) continue;
+
+      // ensure that none of the excluded terms is in the search result
+      for (i = 0; i < excluded.length; i++) {
+        if (terms[excluded[i]] == file ||
+            titleterms[excluded[i]] == file ||
+            $u.contains(terms[excluded[i]] || [], file) ||
+            $u.contains(titleterms[excluded[i]] || [], file)) {
+          valid = false;
+          break;
+        }
+      }
+
+      // if we have still a valid result we can add it to the result list
+      if (valid) {
+        // select one (max) score for the file.
+        // for better ranking, we should calculate ranking by using words statistics like basic tf-idf...
+        var score = $u.max($u.map(fileMap[file], function(w){return scoreMap[file][w]}));
+        results.push([docnames[file], titles[file], '', null, score, filenames[file]]);
+      }
+    }
+    return results;
+  },
+
+  /**
+   * helper function to return a node containing the
+   * search summary for a given text. keywords is a list
+   * of stemmed words, hlwords is the list of normal, unstemmed
+   * words. the first one is used to find the occurrence, the
+   * latter for highlighting it.
+   */
+  makeSearchSummary : function(htmlText, keywords, hlwords) {
+    var text = Search.htmlToText(htmlText);
+    var textLower = text.toLowerCase();
+    var start = 0;
+    $.each(keywords, function() {
+      var i = textLower.indexOf(this.toLowerCase());
+      if (i > -1)
+        start = i;
+    });
+    start = Math.max(start - 120, 0);
+    var excerpt = ((start > 0) ? '...' : '') +
+      $.trim(text.substr(start, 240)) +
+      ((start + 240 - text.length) ? '...' : '');
+    var rv = $('<p class="context"></p>').text(excerpt);
+    $.each(hlwords, function() {
+      rv = rv.highlightText(this, 'highlighted');
+    });
+    return rv;
+  }
+};

+  Search.init();
+});

+  <section id="changelog">
+<span id="changes"></span><h1>Changelog<a class="headerlink" href="#changelog" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h1>
+<section id="release-4-1-0-in-development">
+<h2>Release 4.1.0 (in development)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-4-1-0-in-development" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="dependencies">
+<h3>Dependencies<a class="headerlink" href="#dependencies" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Support jinja2-3.0</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="incompatible-changes">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#incompatible-changes" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+</section>
+<section id="deprecated">
+<h3>Deprecated<a class="headerlink" href="#deprecated" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.application.Sphinx.html_theme</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.util.docstrings.extract_metadata()</span></code></p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="features-added">
+<h3>Features added<a class="headerlink" href="#features-added" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>#8107: autodoc: Add <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">class-doc-from</span></code> option to <a class="reference internal" href="usage/extensions/autodoc.html#directive-autoclass" title="autoclass directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">autoclass</span></code></a>
+directive to control the content of the specific class like
+<a href="#id1"><span class="problematic" id="id2">:confval:`autoclass_content`</span></a></p></li>
+<li><p>#8588: autodoc: <a href="#id3"><span class="problematic" id="id4">:confval:`autodoc_type_aliases`</span></a> now supports dotted name. It
+allows you to define an alias for a class with module name like
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">foo.bar.BazClass</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p>#9175: autodoc: Special member is not documented in the module</p></li>
+<li><p>#9195: autodoc: The arguments of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">typing.Literal</span></code> are wrongly rendered</p></li>
+<li><p>#9185: autodoc: <a href="#id5"><span class="problematic" id="id6">:confval:`autodoc_typehints`</span></a> allows <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'both'</span></code> setting to
+allow typehints to be included both in the signature and description</p></li>
+<li><p>#4257: autodoc: Add <a href="#id7"><span class="problematic" id="id8">:confval:`autodoc_class_signature`</span></a> to separate the class
+entry and the definition of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">__init__()</span></code> method</p></li>
+<li><p>#8061, #9218: autodoc: Support variable comment for alias classes</p></li>
+<li><p>#3014: autodoc: Add <a href="#id9"><span class="problematic" id="id10">:event:`autodoc-process-bases`</span></a> to modify the base classes
+of the class definitions</p></li>
+<li><p>#3257: autosummary: Support instance attributes for classes</p></li>
+<li><p>#9129: html search: Show search summaries when html_copy_source = False</p></li>
+<li><p>#9120: html theme: Eliminate prompt characters of code-block from copyable
+text</p></li>
+<li><p>#9176: i18n: Emit a debug message if message catalog file not found under
+<a href="#id11"><span class="problematic" id="id12">:confval:`locale_dirs`</span></a></p></li>
+<li><p>#9097: Optimize the paralell build</p></li>
+<li><p>#9131: Add <a href="#id13"><span class="problematic" id="id14">:confval:`nitpick_ignore_regex`</span></a> to ignore nitpicky warnings using
+regular expressions</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="bugs-fixed">
+<h3>Bugs fixed<a class="headerlink" href="#bugs-fixed" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>#8872: autodoc: stacked singledispatches are wrongly rendered</p></li>
+<li><p>#8597: autodoc: a docsting having metadata only should be treated as
+undocumented</p></li>
+<li><p>#9185: autodoc: typehints for overloaded functions and methods are inaccurate</p></li>
+<li><p>#9217: manpage: The name of manpage directory that is generated by
+<a href="#id15"><span class="problematic" id="id16">:confval:`man_make_section_directory`</span></a> is not correct</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>

+<section id="release-4-0-0-released-may-09-2021">
+<h2>Release 4.0.0 (released May 09, 2021)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-4-0-0-released-may-09-2021" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="id26">
+<h3>Dependencies<a class="headerlink" href="#id26" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>4.0.0b1</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Drop python 3.5 support</p></li>
+<li><p>Drop docutils 0.12 and 0.13 support</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: add <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tex-gyre</span></code> font dependency</p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>4.0.0b2</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Support docutils-0.17.  Please notice it changes the output of HTML builder.
+Some themes do not support it, and you need to update your custom CSS to
+upgrade it.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="id27">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#id27" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>4.0.0b1</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>#8539: autodoc: info-field-list is generated into the class description when
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">autodoc_typehints='description'</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">autoclass_content='class'</span></code> set</p></li>
+<li><p>#8898: extlinks: “%s” becomes required keyword in the link caption string</p></li>
+<li><p>domain: The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Index</span></code> class becomes subclasses of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">abc.ABC</span></code> to indicate
+methods that must be overrided in the concrete classes</p></li>
+<li><p>#4826: py domain: The structure of python objects is changed.  A boolean value
+is added to indicate that the python object is canonical one</p></li>

+configuration for version 3. +<li><p>#7784: i18n: The msgid for alt text of image is changed</p></li>
+<li><p>#5560: napoleon: <a href="#id28"><span class="problematic" id="id29">:confval:`napoleon_use_param`</span></a> also affect “other parameters”

+<li><p>#7996: manpage: Make a section directory on build manpage by default (see
+<a href="#id30"><span class="problematic" id="id31">:confval:`man_make_section_directory`</span></a>)</p></li>

+<li><p>#8380: html search: search results are wrapped with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre"><p></span></code> instead of
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre"><div></span></code></p></li>

+<li><p>#8508: LaTeX: uplatex becomes a default setting of latex_engine for Japanese
+documents</p></li>
+<li><p>#5977: py domain: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:var:</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:cvar:</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:ivar:</span></code> fields do not create

+path as a relative path from source directory</p></li>

+<section id="release-2-0-0-released-mar-29-2019">
+<h2>Release 2.0.0 (released Mar 29, 2019)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-2-0-0-released-mar-29-2019" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="id299">
+<h3>Dependencies<a class="headerlink" href="#id299" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>2.0.0b1</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>LaTeX builder now depends on TeX Live 2015 or above.</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX builder (with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'pdflatex'</span></code> <a href="#id300"><span class="problematic" id="id301">:confval:`latex_engine`</span></a>) will process
+Unicode Greek letters in text (not in math mark-up) via the text font and
+will not escape them to math mark-up. See the discussion of the
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'fontenc'</span></code> key of <a href="#id302"><span class="problematic" id="id303">:confval:`latex_elements`</span></a>; such (optional) support for
+Greek adds, for example on Ubuntu xenial, the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-lang-greek</span></code> and (if
+default font set-up is not modified) <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cm-super(-minimal)</span></code> as additional
+Sphinx LaTeX requirements.</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX builder with <a href="#id304"><span class="problematic" id="id305">:confval:`latex_engine`</span></a> set to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'xelatex'</span></code> or to
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'lualatex'</span></code> requires (by default) the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FreeFont</span></code> fonts,
+which in Ubuntu xenial are provided by package <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fonts-freefont-otf</span></code>, and
+e.g. in Fedora 29 via package <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-gnu-freefont</span></code>.</p></li>
+<li><p>requests 2.5.0 or above</p></li>
+<li><p>The six package is no longer a dependency</p></li>
+<li><p>The sphinxcontrib-websupport package is no longer a dependency</p></li>
+<li><p>Some packages are separated to sub packages:</p>
+<ul>
+<li><p>sphinxcontrib.applehelp</p></li>
+<li><p>sphinxcontrib.devhelp</p></li>
+<li><p>sphinxcontrib.htmlhelp</p></li>
+<li><p>sphinxcontrib.jsmath</p></li>
+<li><p>sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml</p></li>
+<li><p>sphinxcontrib.qthelp</p></li>
+</ul>
+</li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="id306">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#id306" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>2.0.0b1</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Drop python 2.7 and 3.4 support</p></li>
+<li><p>Drop docutils 0.11 support</p></li>
+<li><p>Drop features and APIs deprecated in 1.7.x</p></li>
+<li><p>The default setting for <a href="#id307"><span class="problematic" id="id308">:confval:`master_doc`</span></a> is changed to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'index'</span></code> which
+has been longly used as default of sphinx-quickstart.</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: Move message resources to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinxmessage.sty</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: Stop using <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\captions<lang></span></code> macro for some labels</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'xelatex'</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'lualatex'</span></code>, use the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FreeFont</span></code> OpenType
+fonts as default choice (refs: #5645)</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'xelatex'</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'lualatex'</span></code> now use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\small</span></code> in code-blocks
+(due to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">FreeMono</span></code> character width) like <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'pdflatex'</span></code> already did (due
+to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Courier</span></code> character width).  You may need to adjust this via
+<a href="#id309"><span class="problematic" id="id310">:confval:`latex_elements`</span></a> <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'fvset'</span></code> key, in case of usage of some other
+OpenType fonts (refs: #5768)</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: Greek letters in text are not escaped to math mode mark-up, and they
+will use the text font not the math font. The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">LGR</span></code> font encoding must be
+added to the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'fontenc'</span></code> key of <a href="#id311"><span class="problematic" id="id312">:confval:`latex_elements`</span></a> for this to work
+(only if it is needed by the document, of course).</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: setting the <a href="#id313"><span class="problematic" id="id314">:confval:`language`</span></a> to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'en'</span></code> triggered <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Sonny</span></code> option
+of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fncychap</span></code>, now it is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Bjarne</span></code> to match case of no language specified.
+(refs: #5772)</p></li>
+<li><p>#5770: doctest: Follow <a href="#id315"><span class="problematic" id="id316">:confval:`highlight_language`</span></a> on highlighting doctest
+block.  As a result, they are highlighted as python3 by default.</p></li>
+<li><p>The order of argument for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">HTMLTranslator</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">HTML5Translator</span></code> and
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ManualPageTranslator</span></code> are changed</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: hard-coded redefinitions of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\l@section</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\l@subsection</span></code>
+formerly done during loading of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'manual'</span></code> docclass get executed later, at
+time of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\sphinxtableofcontents</span></code>.  This means that custom user definitions
+from LaTeX preamble now get overwritten.  Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\sphinxtableofcontentshook</span></code>
+to insert custom user definitions.  See <a class="reference internal" href="latex.html#latex-macros"><span class="std std-ref">Macros</span></a>.</p></li>
+<li><p>quickstart: Simplify generated <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">conf.py</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p>#4148: quickstart: some questions are removed.  They are still able to specify
+via command line options</p></li>
+<li><p>websupport: unbundled from sphinx core. Please use sphinxcontrib-websupport</p></li>
+<li><p>C++, the visibility of base classes is now always rendered as present in the
+input. That is, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">private</span></code> is now shown, where it was ellided before.</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX: graphics inclusion of oversized images rescales to not exceed

+<li><p>epub: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">epub_title</span></code> defaults to the <a href="#id317"><span class="problematic" id="id318">:confval:`project`</span></a> option</p></li>
+<li><p>#4550: All tables and figures without <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">align</span></code> option are displayed to center</p></li>
+<li><p>#4587: html: Output HTML5 by default</p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>2.0.0b2</p>

+<section id="release-1-6-1-released-may-16-2017">
+<h2>Release 1.6.1 (released May 16, 2017)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-1-6-1-released-may-16-2017" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="id506">
+<h3>Dependencies<a class="headerlink" href="#id506" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>1.6b1</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>(updated) latex output is tested with Ubuntu trusty’s texlive packages (Feb.
+2014) and earlier tex installations may not be fully compliant, particularly
+regarding Unicode engines xelatex and lualatex</p></li>
+<li><p>(added) latexmk is required for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">make</span> <span class="pre">latexpdf</span></code> on GNU/Linux and Mac OS X
+(refs: #3082)</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="id507">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#id507" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>1.6b1</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>#1061, #2336, #3235: Now generation of autosummary doesn’t contain imported
+members by default. Thanks to Luc Saffre.</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\includegraphics</span></code> command isn’t overloaded: only
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\sphinxincludegraphics</span></code> has the custom code to fit image to available width
+if oversized.</p></li>
+<li><p>The subclasses of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.domains.Index</span></code> should override <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">generate()</span></code>
+method.  The default implementation raises NotImplementedError</p></li>
+<li><p>LaTeX positioned long tables horizontally centered, and short ones
+flushed left (no text flow around table.) The position now defaults to center
+in both cases, and it will obey Docutils 0.13 <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:align:</span></code> option (refs #3415,
+#3377)</p></li>
+<li><p>option directive also allows all punctuations for the option name (refs:
+#3366)</p></li>
+<li><p>#3413: if <a class="reference internal" href="usage/restructuredtext/directives.html#directive-literalinclude" title="literalinclude directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">literalinclude</span></code></a>’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:start-after:</span></code> is used, make
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:lines:</span></code> relative (refs #3412)</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">literalinclude</span></code> directive does not allow the combination of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:diff:</span></code>
+option and other options (refs: #3416)</p></li>
+<li><p>LuaLaTeX engine uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fontspec</span></code> like XeLaTeX. It is advised <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">latex_engine</span>
+<span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">'lualatex'</span></code> be used only on up-to-date TeX installs (refs #3070, #3466)</p></li>
+<li><p><a href="#id508"><span class="problematic" id="id509">:confval:`latex_keep_old_macro_names`</span></a> default value has been changed from
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">True</span></code> to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">False</span></code>. This means that some LaTeX macros for styling are
+by default defined only with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\sphinx..</span></code> prefixed names. (refs: #3429)</p></li>
+<li><p>Footer “Continued on next page” of LaTeX longtable’s now not framed (refs:
+#3497)</p></li>
+<li><p>#3529: The arguments of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BuildEnvironment.__init__</span></code> is changed</p></li>
+<li><p>#3082: Use latexmk for pdf (and dvi) targets (Unix-like platforms only)</p></li>
+<li><p>#3558: Emit warnings if footnotes and citations are not referenced.  The
+warnings can be suppressed by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">suppress_warnings</span></code>.</p></li>
+<li><p>latex made available (non documented) colour macros from a file distributed
+with pdftex engine for Plain TeX. This is removed in order to provide better
+support for multiple TeX engines. Only interface from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">color</span></code> or
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">xcolor</span></code> packages should be used by extensions of Sphinx latex writer.
+(refs #3550)</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Builder.env</span></code> is not filled at instantiation</p></li>
+<li><p>#3594: LaTeX: single raw directive has been considered as block level element</p></li>
+<li><p>#3639: If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">html_experimental_html5_writer</span></code> is available, epub builder use it
+by default.</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Sphinx.add_source_parser()</span></code> raises an error if duplicated</p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>1.6b2</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>#3345: Replace the custom smartypants code with Docutils’ smart_quotes.
+Thanks to Dmitry Shachnev, and to Günter Milde at Docutils.</p></li>
+</ul>

+<li><p>LaTeX package <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">multirow</span></code> is not used and not loaded by Sphinx anymore</p></li>

+<section id="release-1-4-released-mar-28-2016">
+<h2>Release 1.4 (released Mar 28, 2016)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-1-4-released-mar-28-2016" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="id577">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#id577" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Drop <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PorterStemmer</span></code> package support. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PyStemmer</span></code> instead of

+<li><p>sphinx_rtd_theme has become optional. Please install it manually.
+Refs #2087, #2086, #1845 and #2097. Thanks to Victor Zverovich.</p></li>
+<li><p>#2231: Use DUrole instead of DUspan for custom roles in LaTeX writer. It
+enables to take title of roles as an argument of custom macros.</p></li>
+<li><p>#2022: ‘Thumbs.db’ and ‘.DS_Store’ are added to <code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exclude_patterns</span></code> default
+values in conf.py that will be provided on sphinx-quickstart.</p></li>
+<li><p>#2027, #2208: The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">html_title</span></code> accepts string values only. And The None
+value cannot be accepted.</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.ext.graphviz</span></code>: show graph image in inline by default</p></li>
+<li><p>#2060, #2224: The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">manpage</span></code> role now generate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.addnodes.manpage</span></code>
+node instead of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.addnodes.literal_emphasis</span></code> node.</p></li>
+<li><p>#2022: <a href="#id578"><span class="problematic" id="id579">:confval:`html_extra_path`</span></a> also copies dotfiles in the extra directory,
+and refers to <a href="#id580"><span class="problematic" id="id581">:confval:`exclude_patterns`</span></a> to exclude extra files and
+directories.</p></li>
+<li><p>#2300: enhance autoclass:: to use the docstring of __new__ if __init__
+method’s is missing of empty</p></li>
+<li><p>#2251: Previously, under glossary directives, multiple terms for one
+definition are converted into single <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">term</span></code> node and the each terms in the
+term node are separated by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">termsep</span></code> node. In new implementation, each terms
+are converted into individual <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">term</span></code> nodes and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">termsep</span></code> node is removed.
+By this change, output layout of every builders are changed a bit.</p></li>
+<li><p>The default highlight language is now Python 3.  This means that source code
+is highlighted as Python 3 (which is mostly a superset of Python 2), and no
+parsing is attempted to distinguish valid code.  To get the old behavior back,
+add <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">highlight_language</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">"python"</span></code> to conf.py.</p></li>
+<li><p><a class="reference external" href="https://unicode.org/reports/tr35/tr35-dates.html#Date_Format_Patterns">Locale Date Markup Language</a> like
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">"MMMM</span> <span class="pre">dd,</span> <span class="pre">YYYY"</span></code> is default format for <code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">today_fmt</span></code> and
+<code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">html_last_updated_fmt</span></code>.  However strftime format like <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">"%B</span> <span class="pre">%d,</span> <span class="pre">%Y"</span></code> is also
+supported for backward compatibility until Sphinx-1.5. Later format will be
+disabled from Sphinx-1.5.</p></li>

+<li><p>#2337: Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\url{URL}</span></code> macro instead of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">\href{URL}{URL}</span></code> in LaTeX writer.</p></li>

+<section id="id607">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#id607" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Roles <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ref</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">term</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">menusel</span></code> now don’t generate <a href="#id608"><span class="problematic" id="id609">:durole:`emphasis`</span></a>

+<li><p>Role <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">numref</span></code> uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">%s</span></code> as special character to indicate position of

+</ul>

+<section id="id610">
+<h3>Features added<a class="headerlink" href="#id610" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Add convenience directives and roles to the C++ domain:
+directive <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cpp:var</span></code> as alias for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cpp:member</span></code>, role <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:cpp:var</span></code> as alias
+for <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:cpp:member</span></code>, and role <a class="reference internal" href="usage/restructuredtext/roles.html#role-any" title="any role"><code class="xref any rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">any</span></code></a> for cross-reference to any C++
+declaraction. #1577, #1744</p></li>

+suffixes.</p></li>
+<li><p>Add the ability to specify source parsers by source suffix with the
+<a href="#id613"><span class="problematic" id="id614">:confval:`source_parsers`</span></a> config value.</p></li>

+Help Books.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>

+msgid such as “foo bar” and “version changes in 1.3: foo bar”.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1745: latex builder cause maximum recursion depth exceeded when a
+footnote has a footnote mark itself.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1748: SyntaxError in sphinx/ext/ifconfig.py with Python 2.6.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1658, #1750: No link created (and warning given) if option does not

+<li><p>#1753: C++, added missing support for more complex declarations.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1700: Add <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:caption:</span></code> option for <a class="reference internal" href="usage/restructuredtext/directives.html#directive-toctree" title="toctree directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">toctree</span></code></a>.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1742: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:name:</span></code> option is provided for <a class="reference internal" href="usage/restructuredtext/directives.html#directive-toctree" title="toctree directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">toctree</span></code></a>,
+<a class="reference internal" href="usage/restructuredtext/directives.html#directive-code-block" title="code-block directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">code-block</span></code></a> and <a class="reference internal" href="usage/restructuredtext/directives.html#directive-literalinclude" title="literalinclude directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">literalinclude</span></code></a> directives.</p></li>

+<li><p>#1746: C++, fixed name lookup procedure, and added missing lookups in
+declarations.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1765: C++, fix old id generation to use fully qualified names.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="id616">
+<h3>Documentation<a class="headerlink" href="#id616" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>#1651: Add <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">vartype</span></code> field description for python domain.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+</section>

+<h3>Features added<a class="headerlink" href="#id618" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">

+<li><p>Add ‘alabaster’ theme.</p></li>
+<li><p>Add ‘sphinx_rtd_theme’ theme.</p></li>
+<li><p>The ‘default’ html theme has been renamed to ‘classic’. ‘default’ is still

+</li>

+<li><p>‘literal-block’</p></li>
+<li><p>‘doctest-block’</p></li>
+<li><p>‘raw’</p></li>
+<li><p>‘image’</p></li>

+</ul>
+</section>

+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>LaTeX writer now generates correct markup for cells spanning multiple rows.</p></li>

+<li><p>#1687: linkcheck now treats 401 Unauthorized responses as “working”.</p></li>

+<li><p>#1591: html search results for C++ elements now has correct interpage links.</p></li>

+<li><p>#1722: restore <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">toctree()</span></code> template function behavior that was changed at
+1.3b1.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1732: i18n: localized table caption raises exception.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1718: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:numref:</span></code> does not work with capital letters in the label</p></li>

+<section id="release-1-3b1-released-oct-10-2014">
+<h2>Release 1.3b1 (released Oct 10, 2014)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-1-3b1-released-oct-10-2014" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="id625">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#id625" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Dropped support for Python 2.5, 3.1 and 3.2.</p></li>
+<li><p>Dropped support for docutils versions up to 0.9.</p></li>
+<li><p>Removed the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.ext.oldcmarkup</span></code> extension.</p></li>
+<li><p>The deprecated config values <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exclude_trees</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exclude_dirnames</span></code> and

+<li><p>A new node, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.addnodes.literal_strong</span></code>, has been added, for text that

+will have to be adapted to handle this node.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#269, #1476: replace <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre"><tt></span></code> tag by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre"><code></span></code>. User customized stylesheets

+Thanks to Takeshi Komiya.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1543: <code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">templates_path</span></code> is automatically added to
+<code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exclude_patterns</span></code> to avoid reading autosummary rst templates in the
+templates directory.</p></li>
+<li><p>Custom domains should implement the new <a class="reference internal" href="extdev/domainapi.html#sphinx.domains.Domain.resolve_any_xref" title="sphinx.domains.Domain.resolve_any_xref"><code class="xref any py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Domain.resolve_any_xref</span></code></a>

+<li><p>gettext builder: gettext doesn’t emit uuid information to generated pot files
+by default. Please set <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">True</span></code> to <code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">gettext_uuid</span></code> to emit uuid information.
+Additionally, if the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">python-levenshtein</span></code> 3rd-party package is installed,
+it will improve the calculation time.</p></li>
+<li><p>gettext builder: disable extracting/apply ‘index’ node by default. Please set
+‘index’ to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">gettext_enables</span></code> to enable extracting index entries.</p></li>

+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="id626">
+<h3>Features added<a class="headerlink" href="#id626" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Add support for Python 3.4.</p></li>
+<li><p>Add support for docutils 0.12</p></li>
+<li><p>Added <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.ext.napoleon</span></code> extension for NumPy and Google style docstring
+support.</p></li>
+<li><p>Added support for parallel reading (parsing) of source files with the
+<a class="reference internal" href="man/sphinx-build.html#cmdoption-sphinx-build-j"><code class="xref any std std-option docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx-build</span> <span class="pre">-j</span></code></a> option.  Third-party extensions will need to be checked for
+compatibility and may need to be adapted if they store information in the
+build environment object.  See <code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">env-merge-info</span></code>.</p></li>
+<li><p>Added the <a class="reference internal" href="usage/restructuredtext/roles.html#role-any" title="any role"><code class="xref any rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">any</span></code></a> role that can be used to find a cross-reference of

+<a class="reference internal" href="extdev/domainapi.html#sphinx.domains.Domain.resolve_any_xref" title="sphinx.domains.Domain.resolve_any_xref"><code class="xref any py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Domain.resolve_any_xref</span></code></a> method to make this work properly.</p></li>
+<li><p>Exception logs now contain the last 10 messages emitted by Sphinx.</p></li>
+<li><p>Added support for extension versions (a string returned by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">setup()</span></code>, these
+can be shown in the traceback log files).  Version requirements for extensions
+can be specified in projects using the new <code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">needs_extensions</span></code> config

+<section id="release-1-2-beta3-released-oct-3-2013">
+<h2>Release 1.2 beta3 (released Oct 3, 2013)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-1-2-beta3-released-oct-3-2013" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>

+<section id="release-1-2-beta2-released-sep-17-2013">
+<h2>Release 1.2 beta2 (released Sep 17, 2013)<a class="headerlink" href="#release-1-2-beta2-released-sep-17-2013" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="id647">
+<h3>Features added<a class="headerlink" href="#id647" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apidoc</span></code> now ignores “_private” modules by default, and has an option <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-P</span></code>
+to include them.</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apidoc</span></code> now has an option to not generate headings for packages and
+modules, for the case that the module docstring already includes a reST
+heading.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#161: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">apidoc</span></code> can now write each module to a standalone page instead of
+combining all modules in a package on one page.</p></li>
+<li><p>Builders: rebuild i18n target document when catalog updated.</p></li>
+<li><p>Support docutils.conf ‘writers’ and ‘html4css1 writer’ section in the HTML
+writer.  The latex, manpage and texinfo writers also support their respective
+‘writers’ sections.</p></li>
+<li><p>The new <code class="xref any docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">html_extra_path</span></code> config value allows to specify directories
+with files that should be copied directly to the HTML output directory.</p></li>
+<li><p>Autodoc directives for module data and attributes now support an
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">annotation</span></code> option, so that the default display of the data/attribute
+value can be overridden.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#136: Autodoc directives now support an <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">imported-members</span></code> option to
+include members imported from different modules.</p></li>
+<li><p>New locales: Macedonian, Sinhala, Indonesian.</p></li>
+<li><p>Theme package collection by using setuptools plugin mechanism.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="id648">
+<h3>Incompatible changes<a class="headerlink" href="#id648" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>PR#144, #1182: Force timezone offset to LocalTimeZone on POT-Creation-Date
+that was generated by gettext builder. Thanks to masklinn and Jakub Wilk.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="id649">
+<h3>Bugs fixed<a class="headerlink" href="#id649" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>PR#132: Updated jQuery version to 1.8.3.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#141, #982: Avoid crash when writing PNG file using Python 3. Thanks to
+Marcin Wojdyr.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#145: In parallel builds, sphinx drops second document file to write.
+Thanks to tychoish.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#151: Some styling updates to tables in LaTeX.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#153: The “extensions” config value can now be overridden.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#155: Added support for some C++11 function qualifiers.</p></li>
+<li><p>Fix: ‘make gettext’ caused UnicodeDecodeError when templates contain utf-8
+encoded strings.</p></li>
+<li><p>#828: use inspect.getfullargspec() to be able to document functions with

+<li><p>#1090: Fix i18n: multiple cross references (term, ref, doc) in the same line

+<li><p>#1157: Combination of ‘globaltoc.html’ and hidden toctree caused exception.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1159: fix wrong generation of objects inventory for Python modules, and
+add a workaround in intersphinx to fix handling of affected inventories.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1160: Citation target missing caused an AssertionError.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1162, PR#139: singlehtml builder didn’t copy images to _images/.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1173: Adjust setup.py dependencies because Jinja2 2.7 discontinued

+<li><p>#1185: Don’t crash when a Python module has a wrong or no encoding declared,

+<li><p>#1176: Fix i18n: footnote reference number missing for auto numbered named
+footnote and auto symbol footnote.</p></li>
+<li><p>PR#146,#1172: Fix ZeroDivisionError in parallel builds. Thanks to tychoish.</p></li>
+<li><p>#1204: Fix wrong generation of links to local intersphinx targets.</p></li>
