+<section id="sphinx-internationalization-details">
+<h2><a class="toc-backref" href="#id20">Sphinx internationalization details</a><a class="headerlink" href="#sphinx-internationalization-details" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p><strong>gettext</strong> <a class="footnote-reference brackets" href="#id17" id="id1">1</a> is an established standard for internationalization and
+localization.  It naively maps messages in a program to a translated string.
+Sphinx uses these facilities to translate whole documents.</p>
+<p>Initially project maintainers have to collect all translatable strings (also
+referred to as <em>messages</em>) to make them known to translators.  Sphinx extracts
+these through invocation of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx-build</span> <span class="pre">-b</span> <span class="pre">gettext</span></code>.</p>
+<p>Every single element in the doctree will end up in a single message which
+results in lists being equally split into different chunks while large
+paragraphs will remain as coarsely-grained as they were in the original
+document.  This grants seamless document updates while still providing a little
+bit of context for translators in free-text passages.  It is the maintainer’s
+task to split up paragraphs which are too large as there is no sane automated
+way to do that.</p>
+<p>After Sphinx successfully ran the
+<a class="reference internal" href="../builders/index.html#sphinx.builders.gettext.MessageCatalogBuilder" title="sphinx.builders.gettext.MessageCatalogBuilder"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MessageCatalogBuilder</span></code></a> you will find a
+collection of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.pot</span></code> files in your output directory.  These are <strong>catalog
+templates</strong> and contain messages in your original language <em>only</em>.</p>
+<p>They can be delivered to translators which will transform them to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.po</span></code> files
+— so called <strong>message catalogs</strong> — containing a mapping from the original
+messages to foreign-language strings.</p>
+<p><em>gettext</em> compiles them into a binary format known as <strong>binary catalogs</strong>
+through <strong class="program">msgfmt</strong> for efficiency reasons.  If you make these files
+discoverable with <a href="#id2"><span class="problematic" id="id3">:confval:`locale_dirs`</span></a> for your <a href="#id4"><span class="problematic" id="id5">:confval:`language`</span></a>, Sphinx
+will pick them up automatically.</p>
+<p>An example: you have a document <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">usage.rst</span></code> in your Sphinx project.  The
+<em>gettext</em> builder will put its messages into <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">usage.pot</span></code>.  Imagine you have
+Spanish translations <a class="footnote-reference brackets" href="#id18" id="id6">2</a> stored in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">usage.po</span></code> — for your builds to
+be translated you need to follow these instructions:</p>
+<ul>
+<li><p>Compile your message catalog to a locale directory, say <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">locale</span></code>, so it
+ends up in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">./locale/es/LC_MESSAGES/usage.mo</span></code> in your source directory
+(where <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">es</span></code> is the language code for Spanish.)</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">msgfmt</span> <span class="s2">"usage.po"</span> <span class="o">-</span><span class="n">o</span> <span class="s2">"locale/es/LC_MESSAGES/usage.mo"</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</li>
+<li><p>Set <a href="#id7"><span class="problematic" id="id8">:confval:`locale_dirs`</span></a> to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">["locale/"]</span></code>.</p></li>
+<li><p>Set <a href="#id9"><span class="problematic" id="id10">:confval:`language`</span></a> to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">es</span></code> (also possible via
+<a class="reference internal" href="../../man/sphinx-build.html#cmdoption-sphinx-build-D"><code class="xref std std-option docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-D</span></code></a>).</p></li>
+<li><p>Run your desired build.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>
+<section id="translating-with-sphinx-intl">
+<h2><a class="toc-backref" href="#id21">Translating with sphinx-intl</a><a class="headerlink" href="#translating-with-sphinx-intl" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<section id="quick-guide">
+<h3><a class="toc-backref" href="#id22">Quick guide</a><a class="headerlink" href="#quick-guide" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p><a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinx-intl/">sphinx-intl</a> is a useful tool to work with Sphinx translation flow.  This
+section describe an easy way to translate with <em>sphinx-intl</em>.</p>
+<ol class="arabic">
+<li><p>Install <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinx-intl/">sphinx-intl</a>.</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>sphinx-intl
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</li>
+<li><p>Add configurations to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">conf.py</span></code>.</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">locale_dirs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'locale/'</span><span class="p">]</span>   <span class="c1"># path is example but recommended.</span>
+<span class="n">gettext_compact</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">False</span>     <span class="c1"># optional.</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>This case-study assumes that BUILDDIR is set to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_build</span></code>,
+<a href="#id11"><span class="problematic" id="id12">:confval:`locale_dirs`</span></a> is set to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">locale/</span></code> and <a href="#id13"><span class="problematic" id="id14">:confval:`gettext_compact`</span></a>
+is set to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">False</span></code> (the Sphinx document is already configured as such).</p>
+</li>
+<li><p>Extract translatable messages into pot files.</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>make<span class="w"> </span>gettext
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>The generated pot files will be placed in the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_build/gettext</span></code> directory.</p>
+</li>
+<li><p>Generate po files.</p>
+<p>We’ll use the pot files generated in the above step.</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>sphinx-intl<span class="w"> </span>update<span class="w"> </span>-p<span class="w"> </span>_build/gettext<span class="w"> </span>-l<span class="w"> </span>de<span class="w"> </span>-l<span class="w"> </span>ja
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>Once completed, the generated po files will be placed in the below
+directories:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">./locale/de/LC_MESSAGES/</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">./locale/ja/LC_MESSAGES/</span></code></p></li>
+</ul>
+</li>
+<li><p>Translate po files.</p>
+<p>AS noted above, these are located in the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">./locale/<lang>/LC_MESSAGES</span></code>
+directory.  An example of one such file, from Sphinx, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">builders.po</span></code>, is
+given below.</p>
+<div class="highlight-po notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># a5600c3d2e3d48fc8c261ea0284db79b</span>
+<span class="kd">#: ../../builders.rst:4</span>
+<span class="nv">msgid</span> <span class="s">"Available builders"</span>
+<span class="nv">msgstr</span> <span class="s">"<FILL HERE BY TARGET LANGUAGE>"</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>Another case, msgid is multi-line text and contains reStructuredText syntax:</p>
+<div class="highlight-po notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># 302558364e1d41c69b3277277e34b184</span>
+<span class="kd">#: ../../builders.rst:9</span>
+<span class="nv">msgid</span> <span class="s">""</span>
+<span class="s">"These are the built-in Sphinx builders. More builders can be added by "</span>
+<span class="s">":ref:`extensions <extensions>`."</span>
+<span class="nv">msgstr</span> <span class="s">""</span>
+<span class="s">"FILL HERE BY TARGET LANGUAGE FILL HERE BY TARGET LANGUAGE FILL HERE "</span>
+<span class="s">"BY TARGET LANGUAGE :ref:`EXTENSIONS <extensions>` FILL HERE."</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>Please be careful not to break reST notation.  Most po-editors will help you
+with that.</p>
+</li>
+<li><p>Build translated document.</p>
+<p>You need a <a href="#id15"><span class="problematic" id="id16">:confval:`language`</span></a> parameter in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">conf.py</span></code> or you may also
+specify the parameter on the command line.</p>
+<p>For for BSD/GNU make, run:</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>make<span class="w"> </span>-e<span class="w"> </span><span class="nv">SPHINXOPTS</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"-D language='de'"</span><span class="w"> </span>html
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>For Windows <strong class="command">cmd.exe</strong>, run:</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="go">> set SPHINXOPTS=-D language=de</span>
+<span class="go">> .\make.bat html</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>For PowerShell, run:</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="go">> Set-Item env:SPHINXOPTS "-D language=de"</span>
+<span class="go">> .\make.bat html</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</li>
+</ol>
+<p>Congratulations! You got the translated documentation in the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_build/html</span></code>
+directory.</p>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 1.3: </span><strong class="program">sphinx-build</strong> that is invoked by make command will build po files
+into mo files.</p>
+<p>If you are using 1.2.x or earlier, please invoke <strong class="command">sphinx-intl build</strong>
+command before <strong class="command">make</strong> command.</p>
+</div>
+</section>
+<section id="translating">
+<h3><a class="toc-backref" href="#id23">Translating</a><a class="headerlink" href="#translating" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+</section>
+<section id="update-your-po-files-by-new-pot-files">
+<h3><a class="toc-backref" href="#id24">Update your po files by new pot files</a><a class="headerlink" href="#update-your-po-files-by-new-pot-files" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>If a document is updated, it is necessary to generate updated pot files and to
+apply differences to translated po files.  In order to apply the updates from a
+pot file to the po file, use the <strong class="command">sphinx-intl update</strong> command.</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>sphinx-intl<span class="w"> </span>update<span class="w"> </span>-p<span class="w"> </span>_build/locale
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</section>
+</section>
+<section id="using-transifex-service-for-team-translation">
+<h2><a class="toc-backref" href="#id25">Using Transifex service for team translation</a><a class="headerlink" href="#using-transifex-service-for-team-translation" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p><a class="reference external" href="https://www.transifex.com/">Transifex</a> is one of several services that allow collaborative translation via a
+web interface.  It has a nifty Python-based command line client that makes it
+easy to fetch and push translations.</p>
+<ol class="arabic">
+<li><p>Install <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/transifex-client/">transifex-client</a>.</p>
+<p>You need <strong class="command">tx</strong> command to upload resources (pot files).</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>transifex-client
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<div class="admonition seealso">
+<p class="admonition-title">See also</p>
+<p><a class="reference external" href="https://docs.transifex.com/client/introduction/">Transifex Client documentation</a></p>
+</div>
+</li>
+<li><p>Create your <a class="reference external" href="https://www.transifex.com/">transifex</a> account and create new project for your document.</p>
+<p>Currently, transifex does not allow for a translation project to have more
+than one version of the document, so you’d better include a version number in
+your project name.</p>
+<p>For example:</p>
+<dl class="field-list simple">
+<dt class="field-odd">Project ID</dt>
+<dd class="field-odd"><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx-document-test_1_0</span></code></p>
+</dd>
+<dt class="field-even">Project URL</dt>
+<dd class="field-even"><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">https://www.transifex.com/projects/p/sphinx-document-test_1_0/</span></code></p>
+</dd>
+</dl>
+</li>
+<li><p>Create config files for <strong class="command">tx</strong> command.</p>
+<p>This process will create <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.tx/config</span></code> in the current directory, as well as
+a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">~/.transifexrc</span></code> file that includes auth information.</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>tx<span class="w"> </span>init
+<span class="go">Creating .tx folder...</span>
+<span class="go">Transifex instance [https://www.transifex.com]:</span>
+<span class="go">...</span>
+<span class="go">Please enter your transifex username: <transifex-username></span>
+<span class="go">Password: <transifex-password></span>
+<span class="go">...</span>
+<span class="go">Done.</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</li>
+<li><p>Upload pot files to transifex service.</p>
+<p>Register pot files to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">.tx/config</span></code> file:</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span><span class="nb">cd</span><span class="w"> </span>/your/document/root
+<span class="gp">$ </span>sphinx-intl<span class="w"> </span>update-txconfig-resources<span class="w"> </span>--pot-dir<span class="w"> </span>_build/locale<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
+<span class="w">  </span>--transifex-project-name<span class="w"> </span>sphinx-document-test_1_0
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>and upload pot files:</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>tx<span class="w"> </span>push<span class="w"> </span>-s
+<span class="go">Pushing translations for resource sphinx-document-test_1_0.builders:</span>
+<span class="go">Pushing source file (locale/pot/builders.pot)</span>
+<span class="go">Resource does not exist.  Creating...</span>
+<span class="go">...</span>
+<span class="go">Done.</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</li>
+<li><p>Forward the translation on transifex.</p>
+</li>
+<li><p>Pull translated po files and make translated HTML.</p>
+<p>Get translated catalogs and build mo files. For example, to build mo files
+for German (de):</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span><span class="nb">cd</span><span class="w"> </span>/your/document/root
+<span class="gp">$ </span>tx<span class="w"> </span>pull<span class="w"> </span>-l<span class="w"> </span>de
+<span class="go">Pulling translations for resource sphinx-document-test_1_0.builders (...)</span>
+<span class="go"> -> de: locale/de/LC_MESSAGES/builders.po</span>
+<span class="go">...</span>
+<span class="go">Done.</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>Invoke <strong class="command">make html</strong> (for BSD/GNU make):</p>
+<div class="highlight-console notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="gp">$ </span>make<span class="w"> </span>-e<span class="w"> </span><span class="nv">SPHINXOPTS</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"-D language='de'"</span><span class="w"> </span>html
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</li>
+</ol>
+<p>That’s all!</p>
+<div class="admonition tip">
+<p class="admonition-title">Tip</p>
+<p>Translating locally and on Transifex</p>
+<p>If you want to push all language’s po files, you can be done by using
+<strong class="command">tx push -t</strong> command.  Watch out! This operation overwrites
+translations in transifex.</p>
+<p>In other words, if you have updated each in the service and local po files,
+it would take much time and effort to integrate them.</p>
+</div>
+</section>
+<section id="contributing-to-sphinx-reference-translation">
+<h2><a class="toc-backref" href="#id26">Contributing to Sphinx reference translation</a><a class="headerlink" href="#contributing-to-sphinx-reference-translation" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>The recommended way for new contributors to translate Sphinx reference is to
+join the translation team on Transifex.</p>
+<p>There is a <a class="reference external" href="https://www.transifex.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx-doc/">sphinx translation page</a> for Sphinx (master) documentation.</p>
+<ol class="arabic simple">
+<li><p>Login to <a class="reference external" href="https://www.transifex.com/">transifex</a> service.</p></li>
+<li><p>Go to <a class="reference external" href="https://www.transifex.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx-doc/">sphinx translation page</a>.</p></li>
+<li><p>Click <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Request</span> <span class="pre">language</span></code> and fill form.</p></li>
+<li><p>Wait acceptance by transifex sphinx translation maintainers.</p></li>
+<li><p>(After acceptance) Translate on transifex.</p></li>
+</ol>
+<p>Detail is here: <a class="reference external" href="https://docs.transifex.com/getting-started-1/translators">https://docs.transifex.com/getting-started-1/translators</a></p>
+<p class="rubric">Footnotes</p>
+<dl class="footnote brackets">
+<dt class="label" id="id17"><span class="brackets"><a class="fn-backref" href="#id1">1</a></span></dt>
+<dd><p>See the <a class="reference external" href="https://www.gnu.org/software/gettext/manual/gettext.html#Introduction">GNU gettext utilities</a>
+for details on that software suite.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt class="label" id="id18"><span class="brackets"><a class="fn-backref" href="#id6">2</a></span></dt>
+<dd><p>Because nobody expects the Spanish Inquisition!</p>
+</dd>
+</dl>
+</section>

+  <section id="setuptools-integration">
+<span id="setuptools"></span><h1>Setuptools integration<a class="headerlink" href="#setuptools-integration" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h1>
+<p>Sphinx supports integration with setuptools and distutils through a custom
+command - <code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BuildDoc</span></code>.</p>
+<section id="using-setuptools-integration">
+<h2>Using setuptools integration<a class="headerlink" href="#using-setuptools-integration" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>The Sphinx build can then be triggered from distutils, and some Sphinx
+options can be set in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">setup.py</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">setup.cfg</span></code> instead of Sphinx’s own
+configuration file.</p>
+<p>For instance, from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">setup.py</span></code>:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># this is only necessary when not using setuptools/distribute</span>

+            <span class="s1">'project'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'setup.py'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">name</span><span class="p">),</span>
+            <span class="s1">'version'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'setup.py'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">version</span><span class="p">),</span>
+            <span class="s1">'release'</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'setup.py'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">release</span><span class="p">),</span>

+<span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>If you set Sphinx options directly in the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">setup()</span></code> command, replace

+<span class="n">project</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'My project'</span>
+<span class="n">version</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">1.2</span>

+<span class="n">source</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="nb">dir</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s1">'doc'</span>

+</div>
+<p>Once configured, call this by calling the relevant command on <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">setup.py</span></code>:</p>

+  <section id="the-websupport-class">
+<span id="websupportapi"></span><h1>The WebSupport Class<a class="headerlink" href="#the-websupport-class" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h1>
+<dl class="py class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport">
+<em class="property"><span class="pre">class</span> </em><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">sphinxcontrib.websupport.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">WebSupport</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>The main API class for the web support package.  All interactions with the
+web support package should occur through this class.</p>
+<p>The class takes the following keyword arguments:</p>
+<dl>
+<dt>srcdir</dt><dd><p>The directory containing reStructuredText source files.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt>builddir</dt><dd><p>The directory that build data and static files should be placed in.  This
+should be used when creating a <a class="reference internal" href="#sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">WebSupport</span></code></a> object that will be
+used to build data.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt>datadir</dt><dd><p>The directory that the web support data is in.  This should be used when
+creating a <a class="reference internal" href="#sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">WebSupport</span></code></a> object that will be used to retrieve data.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt>search</dt><dd><p>This may contain either a string (e.g. ‘xapian’) referencing a built-in
+search adapter to use, or an instance of a subclass of
+<a class="reference internal" href="searchadapters.html#sphinxcontrib.websupport.search.BaseSearch" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.search.BaseSearch"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">BaseSearch</span></code></a>.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt>storage</dt><dd><p>This may contain either a string representing a database uri, or an
+instance of a subclass of <a class="reference internal" href="storagebackends.html#sphinxcontrib.websupport.storage.StorageBackend" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.storage.StorageBackend"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">StorageBackend</span></code></a>.  If this is
+not provided, a new sqlite database will be created.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt>moderation_callback</dt><dd><p>A callable to be called when a new comment is added that is not
+displayed.  It must accept one argument: a dictionary representing the
+comment that was added.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt>staticdir</dt><dd><p>If the static files should be created in a different location
+<strong>and not in</strong> <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'/static'</span></code>, this should be a string with the name of
+that location (e.g. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">builddir</span> <span class="pre">+</span> <span class="pre">'/static_files'</span></code>).</p>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>If you specify <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">staticdir</span></code>, you will typically want to adjust
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">staticroot</span></code> accordingly.</p>
+</div>
+</dd>
+<dt>staticroot</dt><dd><p>If the static files are not served from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'/static'</span></code>, this should be a
+string with the name of that location (e.g. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'/static_files'</span></code>).</p>
+</dd>
+<dt>docroot</dt><dd><p>If the documentation is not served from the base path of a URL, this
+should be a string specifying that path (e.g. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'docs'</span></code>).</p>
+</dd>
+</dl>

+<span id="websupportquickstart"></span><h1>Web Support Quick Start<a class="headerlink" href="#web-support-quick-start" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h1>
+<section id="building-documentation-data">
+<h2>Building Documentation Data<a class="headerlink" href="#building-documentation-data" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>To make use of the web support package in your application you’ll need to build
+the data it uses.  This data includes pickle files representing documents,
+search indices, and node data that is used to track where comments and other
+things are in a document.  To do this you will need to create an instance of the
+<a class="reference internal" href="api.html#sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">WebSupport</span></code></a> class and call its <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">build()</span></code> method:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span> <span class="nn">sphinxcontrib.websupport</span> <span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">WebSupport</span>
+
+<span class="n">support</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">WebSupport</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">srcdir</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'/path/to/rst/sources/'</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                     <span class="n">builddir</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'/path/to/build/outdir'</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                     <span class="n">search</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'xapian'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+
+<span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">build</span><span class="p">()</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>This will read reStructuredText sources from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">srcdir</span></code> and place the necessary
+data in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">builddir</span></code>.  The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">builddir</span></code> will contain two sub-directories: one
+named “data” that contains all the data needed to display documents, search
+through documents, and add comments to documents.  The other directory will be
+called “static” and contains static files that should be served from “/static”.</p>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>If you wish to serve static files from a path other than “/static”, you can
+do so by providing the <em>staticdir</em> keyword argument when creating the
+<a class="reference internal" href="api.html#sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">WebSupport</span></code></a> object.</p>
+</div>
+</section>
+<section id="integrating-sphinx-documents-into-your-webapp">
+<h2>Integrating Sphinx Documents Into Your Webapp<a class="headerlink" href="#integrating-sphinx-documents-into-your-webapp" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>Now that the data is built, it’s time to do something useful with it.  Start off
+by creating a <a class="reference internal" href="api.html#sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">WebSupport</span></code></a> object for your application:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span> <span class="nn">sphinxcontrib.websupport</span> <span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">WebSupport</span>
+
+<span class="n">support</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">WebSupport</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">datadir</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'/path/to/the/data'</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                     <span class="n">search</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'xapian'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>You’ll only need one of these for each set of documentation you will be working
+with.  You can then call its <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_document()</span></code> method to access
+individual documents:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">contents</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'contents'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>This will return a dictionary containing the following items:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><strong>body</strong>: The main body of the document as HTML</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>sidebar</strong>: The sidebar of the document as HTML</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>relbar</strong>: A div containing links to related documents</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>title</strong>: The title of the document</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>css</strong>: Links to CSS files used by Sphinx</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>script</strong>: JavaScript containing comment options</p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>This dict can then be used as context for templates.  The goal is to be easy to
+integrate with your existing templating system.  An example using <a class="reference external" href="https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/">Jinja2</a> is:</p>
+<div class="highlight-html+jinja notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">extends</span> <span class="s2">"layout.html"</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">block</span> <span class="nv">title</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nv">document.title</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">endblock</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+
+<span class="cp">{%</span> <span class="k">block</span> <span class="nv">css</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nb">super</span><span class="o">()</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nv">document.css</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="nf">safe</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+    <span class="p"><</span><span class="nt">link</span> <span class="na">rel</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">"stylesheet"</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">"/static/websupport-custom.css"</span> <span class="na">type</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">"text/css"</span><span class="p">></span>
+<span class="cp">{%</span> <span class="k">endblock</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">block</span> <span class="nv">script</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nb">super</span><span class="o">()</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nv">document.script</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="nf">safe</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">endblock</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">block</span> <span class="nv">relbar</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nv">document.relbar</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="nf">safe</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">endblock</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">block</span> <span class="nv">body</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nv">document.body</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="nf">safe</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">endblock</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">block</span> <span class="nv">sidebar</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+    <span class="cp">{{</span> <span class="nv">document.sidebar</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="nf">safe</span> <span class="cp">}}</span>
+<span class="cp">{%</span>- <span class="k">endblock</span> <span class="cp">%}</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<section id="authentication">
+<h3>Authentication<a class="headerlink" href="#authentication" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>To use certain features such as voting, it must be possible to authenticate
+users.  The details of the authentication are left to your application.  Once a
+user has been authenticated you can pass the user’s details to certain
+<a class="reference internal" href="api.html#sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport" title="sphinxcontrib.websupport.WebSupport"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">WebSupport</span></code></a> methods using the <em>username</em> and <em>moderator</em> keyword
+arguments.  The web support package will store the username with comments and
+votes.  The only caveat is that if you allow users to change their username you
+must update the websupport package’s data:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update_username</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">old_username</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">new_username</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p><em>username</em> should be a unique string which identifies a user, and <em>moderator</em>
+should be a boolean representing whether the user has moderation privileges.
+The default value for <em>moderator</em> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">False</span></code>.</p>
+<p>An example <a class="reference external" href="https://flask.palletsprojects.com/">Flask</a> function that checks whether a
+user is logged in and then retrieves a document is:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span> <span class="nn">sphinxcontrib.websupport.errors</span> <span class="kn">import</span> <span class="o">*</span>
+
+<span class="nd">@app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/<path:docname>'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+<span class="k">def</span> <span class="nf">doc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">docname</span><span class="p">):</span>
+    <span class="n">username</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">name</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="s1">''</span>
+    <span class="n">moderator</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">moderator</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="kc">False</span>
+    <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
+        <span class="n">document</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_document</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">docname</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">username</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">moderator</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">DocumentNotFoundError</span><span class="p">:</span>
+        <span class="n">abort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">404</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">render_template</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'doc.html'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">document</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">document</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>The first thing to notice is that the <em>docname</em> is just the request path.  This
+makes accessing the correct document easy from a single view.  If the user is
+authenticated, then the username and moderation status are passed along with the
+docname to <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_document()</span></code>.  The web support package will then
+add this data to the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">COMMENT_OPTIONS</span></code> that are used in the template.</p>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>This only works if your documentation is served from your
+document root. If it is served from another directory, you will
+need to prefix the url route with that directory, and give the <cite>docroot</cite>
+keyword argument when creating the web support object:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">support</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">WebSupport</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">...</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">docroot</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'docs'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+
+<span class="nd">@app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/docs/<path:docname>'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</div>
+</section>
+</section>
+<section id="performing-searches">
+<h2>Performing Searches<a class="headerlink" href="#performing-searches" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>To use the search form built-in to the Sphinx sidebar, create a function to
+handle requests to the URL ‘search’ relative to the documentation root.  The
+user’s search query will be in the GET parameters, with the key <cite>q</cite>.  Then use
+the <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_search_results()</span></code> method to
+retrieve search results. In <a class="reference external" href="https://flask.palletsprojects.com/">Flask</a> that would be
+like this:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/search'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+<span class="k">def</span> <span class="nf">search</span><span class="p">():</span>
+    <span class="n">q</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">args</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'q'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">document</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_search_results</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">q</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">render_template</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'doc.html'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">document</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">document</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>Note that we used the same template to render our search results as we did to
+render our documents.  That’s because <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_search_results()</span></code>
+returns a context dict in the same format that <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_document()</span></code>
+does.</p>
+</section>
+<section id="comments-proposals">
+<h2>Comments & Proposals<a class="headerlink" href="#comments-proposals" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>Now that this is done it’s time to define the functions that handle the AJAX
+calls from the script.  You will need three functions.  The first function is
+used to add a new comment, and will call the web support method
+<code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">add_comment()</span></code>:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/docs/add_comment'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">methods</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'POST'</span><span class="p">])</span>
+<span class="k">def</span> <span class="nf">add_comment</span><span class="p">():</span>
+    <span class="n">parent_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">form</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'parent'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">''</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">node_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">form</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'node'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">''</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">form</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'text'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">''</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">proposal</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">form</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'proposal'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">''</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">username</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">name</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="s1">'Anonymous'</span>
+    <span class="n">comment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_comment</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">node_id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'node_id'</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                                  <span class="n">parent_id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'parent_id'</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                                  <span class="n">username</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">proposal</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">proposal</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">jsonify</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">comment</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">comment</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>You’ll notice that both a <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parent_id</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">node_id</span></code> are sent with the
+request. If the comment is being attached directly to a node, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parent_id</span></code>
+will be empty. If the comment is a child of another comment, then <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">node_id</span></code>
+will be empty. Then next function handles the retrieval of comments for a
+specific node, and is aptly named
+<code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_data()</span></code>:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/docs/get_comments'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+<span class="k">def</span> <span class="nf">get_comments</span><span class="p">():</span>
+    <span class="n">username</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">name</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
+    <span class="n">moderator</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">moderator</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="kc">False</span>
+    <span class="n">node_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">args</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'node'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">''</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get_data</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">node_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">username</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">moderator</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">jsonify</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">**</span><span class="n">data</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>The final function that is needed will call <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">process_vote()</span></code>,
+and will handle user votes on comments:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/docs/process_vote'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">methods</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'POST'</span><span class="p">])</span>
+<span class="k">def</span> <span class="nf">process_vote</span><span class="p">():</span>
+    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
+        <span class="n">abort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">401</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">comment_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">form</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'comment_id'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">value</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">request</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">form</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'value'</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">value</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">comment_id</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
+        <span class="n">abort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">400</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">process_vote</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">comment_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">value</span><span class="p">)</span>
+    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="s2">"success"</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</section>
+<section id="comment-moderation">
+<h2>Comment Moderation<a class="headerlink" href="#comment-moderation" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>By default, all comments added through <code class="xref py py-meth docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">add_comment()</span></code> are
+automatically displayed.  If you wish to have some form of moderation, you can
+pass the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">displayed</span></code> keyword argument:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">comment</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">support</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_comment</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">node_id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'node_id'</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                              <span class="n">parent_id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'parent_id'</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                              <span class="n">username</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">username</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">proposal</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">proposal</span><span class="p">,</span>
+                              <span class="n">displayed</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>You can then create a new view to handle the moderation of comments.  It
+will be called when a moderator decides a comment should be accepted and
+displayed:</p>
+<div class="highlight-default notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@app</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">route</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'/docs/accept_comment'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">methods</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'POST'</span><span class="p">])</span>
+<span class="k">def</span> <span class="nf">accept_comment</span><span class="p">():</span>
+    <span class="n">moderator</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">moderator</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">g</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">user</span> <span class="k">else</span> <span class="kc">False</span>

+</div>
+<p>Rejecting comments happens via comment deletion.</p>
+<p>To perform a custom action (such as emailing a moderator) when a new comment is

+</div>

+<span class="target" id="module-sphinx.builders.latex"></span><dl class="py class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object py" id="sphinx.builders.latex.LaTeXBuilder">
+<em class="property"><span class="pre">class</span> </em><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">sphinx.builders.latex.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">LaTeXBuilder</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#sphinx.builders.latex.LaTeXBuilder" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>This builder produces a bunch of LaTeX files in the output directory.  You
+have to specify which documents are to be included in which LaTeX files via
+the <a href="#id4"><span class="problematic" id="id5">:confval:`latex_documents`</span></a> configuration value.  There are a few
+configuration values that customize the output of this builder, see the
+chapter <a class="reference internal" href="../configuration.html#latex-options"><span class="std std-ref">Options for LaTeX output</span></a> for details.</p>
+<p>The produced LaTeX file uses several LaTeX packages that may not be present
+in a “minimal” TeX distribution installation.</p>
+<p>On Ubuntu xenial, the following packages need to be installed for
+successful PDF builds:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-latex-recommended</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-fonts-recommended</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tex-gyre</span></code> (if <a href="#id6"><span class="problematic" id="id7">:confval:`latex_engine`</span></a> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'pdflatex'</span></code>)</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-latex-extra</span></code></p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">latexmk</span></code> (this is a Sphinx requirement on GNU/Linux and MacOS X
+for functioning of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">make</span> <span class="pre">latexpdf</span></code>)</p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>Additional packages are needed in some circumstances (see the discussion of
+the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'fontpkg'</span></code> key of <a href="#id8"><span class="problematic" id="id9">:confval:`latex_elements`</span></a> for more information):</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-lang-cyrillic</span></code> for Cyrillic (even individual letters), and,
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cm-super</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cm-super-minimal</span></code> (if default fonts),</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-lang-greek</span></code> for Greek (even individual letters), and,
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cm-super</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cm-super-minimal</span></code> (if default fonts),</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-xetex</span></code> if <a href="#id10"><span class="problematic" id="id11">:confval:`latex_engine`</span></a> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'xelatex'</span></code>,</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">texlive-luatex</span></code> if <a href="#id12"><span class="problematic" id="id13">:confval:`latex_engine`</span></a> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'lualatex'</span></code>,</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fonts-freefont-otf</span></code> if <a href="#id14"><span class="problematic" id="id15">:confval:`latex_engine`</span></a> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'xelatex'</span></code>
+or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'lualatex'</span></code>.</p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>The testing of Sphinx LaTeX is done on Ubuntu xenial whose TeX distribution
+is based on a TeXLive 2015 snapshot dated March 2016.</p>
+<div class="versionchanged">
+<p><span class="versionmodified changed">Changed in version 1.6: </span>Formerly, testing had been done on Ubuntu precise (TeXLive 2009).</p>
+</div>
+<div class="versionchanged">
+<p><span class="versionmodified changed">Changed in version 2.0: </span>Formerly, testing had been done on Ubuntu trusty (TeXLive 2013).</p>
+</div>
+<div class="versionchanged">
+<p><span class="versionmodified changed">Changed in version 4.0.0: </span>TeX Gyre fonts dependency for the default LaTeX font configuration.</p>
+</div>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>Since 1.6, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">make</span> <span class="pre">latexpdf</span></code> uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">latexmk</span></code> (not on Windows).  This
+makes sure the needed number of runs is automatically executed to get
+the cross-references, bookmarks, indices, and tables of contents right.</p>

+<section id="serialization-builder-details">
+<span id="serialization-details"></span><h2>Serialization builder details<a class="headerlink" href="#serialization-builder-details" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>All serialization builders outputs one file per source file and a few special
+files.  They also copy the reST source files in the directory <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_sources</span></code>
+under the output directory.</p>
+<p>The <a class="reference internal" href="#sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.PickleHTMLBuilder" title="sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.PickleHTMLBuilder"><code class="xref py py-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PickleHTMLBuilder</span></code></a> is a builtin subclass that implements the pickle
+serialization interface.</p>
+<p>The files per source file have the extensions of
+<a class="reference internal" href="#sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.SerializingHTMLBuilder.out_suffix" title="sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.SerializingHTMLBuilder.out_suffix"><code class="xref py py-attr docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">out_suffix</span></code></a>, and are arranged in directories
+just as the source files are.  They unserialize to a dictionary (or dictionary
+like structure) with these keys:</p>
+<dl class="simple">
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">body</span></code></dt><dd><p>The HTML “body” (that is, the HTML rendering of the source file), as rendered
+by the HTML translator.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">title</span></code></dt><dd><p>The title of the document, as HTML (may contain markup).</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">toc</span></code></dt><dd><p>The table of contents for the file, rendered as an HTML <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre"><ul></span></code>.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">display_toc</span></code></dt><dd><p>A boolean that is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">True</span></code> if the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">toc</span></code> contains more than one entry.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">current_page_name</span></code></dt><dd><p>The document name of the current file.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parents</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prev</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next</span></code></dt><dd><p>Information about related chapters in the TOC tree.  Each relation is a
+dictionary with the keys <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">link</span></code> (HREF for the relation) and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">title</span></code>
+(title of the related document, as HTML).  <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">parents</span></code> is a list of
+relations, while <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prev</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">next</span></code> are a single relation.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sourcename</span></code></dt><dd><p>The name of the source file under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">_sources</span></code>.</p>
+</dd>
+</dl>
+<p>The special files are located in the root output directory.  They are:</p>
+<dl>
+<dt><a class="reference internal" href="#sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.SerializingHTMLBuilder.globalcontext_filename" title="sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.SerializingHTMLBuilder.globalcontext_filename"><code class="xref py py-attr docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SerializingHTMLBuilder.globalcontext_filename</span></code></a></dt><dd><p>A pickled dict with these keys:</p>
+<dl class="simple">
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">project</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">copyright</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">release</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">version</span></code></dt><dd><p>The same values as given in the configuration file.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">style</span></code></dt><dd><p><a href="#id22"><span class="problematic" id="id23">:confval:`html_style`</span></a>.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">last_updated</span></code></dt><dd><p>Date of last build.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">builder</span></code></dt><dd><p>Name of the used builder, in the case of pickles this is always
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">'pickle'</span></code>.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">titles</span></code></dt><dd><p>A dictionary of all documents’ titles, as HTML strings.</p>
+</dd>
+</dl>
+</dd>
+<dt><a class="reference internal" href="#sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.SerializingHTMLBuilder.searchindex_filename" title="sphinxcontrib.serializinghtml.SerializingHTMLBuilder.searchindex_filename"><code class="xref py py-attr docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SerializingHTMLBuilder.searchindex_filename</span></code></a></dt><dd><p>An index that can be used for searching the documentation.  It is a pickled
+list with these entries:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>A list of indexed docnames.</p></li>
+<li><p>A list of document titles, as HTML strings, in the same order as the first
+list.</p></li>
+<li><p>A dict mapping word roots (processed by an English-language stemmer) to a
+list of integers, which are indices into the first list.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">environment.pickle</span></code></dt><dd><p>The build environment.  This is always a pickle file, independent of the
+builder and a copy of the environment that was used when the builder was
+started.</p>
+<p>Unlike the other pickle files this pickle file requires that the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx</span></code>
+package is available on unpickling.</p>
+</dd>
+</dl>

+<span id="configuration"></span><span id="build-config"></span><h1>Configuration<a class="headerlink" href="#module-conf" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h1>
+<p>The <a class="reference internal" href="../glossary.html#term-configuration-directory"><span class="xref std std-term">configuration directory</span></a> must contain a file named <code class="file docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">conf.py</span></code>.
+This file (containing Python code) is called the “build configuration file”
+and contains (almost) all configuration needed to customize Sphinx input
+and output behavior.</p>
+<blockquote>
+<div><p>An optional file <a class="reference external" href="https://docutils.sourceforge.io/docs/user/config.html">docutils.conf</a> can be added to the configuration
+directory to adjust <a class="reference external" href="https://docutils.sourceforge.io/">Docutils</a> configuration if not otherwise overridden or
+set by Sphinx.</p>
+</div></blockquote>
+<p>The configuration file is executed as Python code at build time (using
+<code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">execfile()</span></code>, and with the current directory set to its containing
+directory), and therefore can execute arbitrarily complex code.  Sphinx then
+reads simple names from the file’s namespace as its configuration.</p>
+<p>Important points to note:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>If not otherwise documented, values must be strings, and their default is the
+empty string.</p></li>
+<li><p>The term “fully-qualified name” refers to a string that names an importable
+Python object inside a module; for example, the FQN
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">"sphinx.builders.Builder"</span></code> means the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Builder</span></code> class in the
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">sphinx.builders</span></code> module.</p></li>
+<li><p>Remember that document names use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">/</span></code> as the path separator and don’t
+contain the file name extension.</p></li>
+<li><p>Since <code class="file docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">conf.py</span></code> is read as a Python file, the usual rules apply for
+encodings and Unicode support.</p></li>
+<li><p>The contents of the config namespace are pickled (so that Sphinx can find out
+when configuration changes), so it may not contain unpickleable values –
+delete them from the namespace with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">del</span></code> if appropriate.  Modules are
+removed automatically, so you don’t need to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">del</span></code> your imports after use.</p>
+</li>
+<li id="conf-tags"><p>There is a special object named <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tags</span></code> available in the config file.
+It can be used to query and change the tags (see <a class="reference internal" href="restructuredtext/directives.html#tags"><span class="std std-ref">Including content based on tags</span></a>).  Use
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tags.has('tag')</span></code> to query, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tags.add('tag')</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tags.remove('tag')</span></code>
+to change. Only tags set via the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">-t</span></code> command-line option or via
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tags.add('tag')</span></code> can be queried using <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tags.has('tag')</span></code>.
+Note that the current builder tag is not available in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">conf.py</span></code>, as it is
+created <em>after</em> the builder is initialized.</p></li>
+</ul>
