+<div class="admonition-note-on-references-with-templates-parameters-arguments admonition">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note on References with Templates Parameters/Arguments</p>
+<p>These roles follow the Sphinx <a class="reference internal" href="roles.html#xref-syntax"><span class="std std-ref">Cross-referencing syntax</span></a> rules. This means care must
+be taken when referencing a (partial) template specialization, e.g. if the
+link looks like this: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:cpp:class:`MyClass<int>`</span></code>.
+This is interpreted as a link to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">int</span></code> with a title of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MyClass</span></code>.
+In this case, escape the opening angle bracket with a backslash,
+like this: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:cpp:class:`MyClass\<int>`</span></code>.</p>
+<p>When a custom title is not needed it may be useful to use the roles for
+inline expressions, <a class="reference internal" href="#role-cpp-expr" title="cpp:expr role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cpp:expr</span></code></a> and <a class="reference internal" href="#role-cpp-texpr" title="cpp:texpr role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cpp:texpr</span></code></a>, where
+angle brackets do not need escaping.</p>
+</div>
+<section id="declarations-without-template-parameters-and-template-arguments">
+<h4>Declarations without template parameters and template arguments<a class="headerlink" href="#declarations-without-template-parameters-and-template-arguments" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h4>
+<p>For linking to non-templated declarations the name must be a nested name, e.g.,
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">f</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">MyClass::f</span></code>.</p>
+</section>
+<section id="overloaded-member-functions">
+<h4>Overloaded (member) functions<a class="headerlink" href="#overloaded-member-functions" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h4>
+<p>When a (member) function is referenced using just its name, the reference
+will point to an arbitrary matching overload.
+The <a class="reference internal" href="#role-cpp-any" title="cpp:any role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cpp:any</span></code></a> and <a class="reference internal" href="#role-cpp-func" title="cpp:func role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cpp:func</span></code></a> roles use an alternative
+format, which simply is a complete function declaration.
+This will resolve to the exact matching overload.
+As example, consider the following class declaration:</p>
+<dl class="cpp class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object cpp" id="_CPPv4N16overload_example1CE">

+<dd><dl class="cpp function">
+<dt class="sig sig-object cpp" id="_CPPv4NK16overload_example1C1fEd">

+<dd></dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="cpp function">
+<dt class="sig sig-object cpp" id="_CPPv4N16overload_example1C1fEd">
+<span id="_CPPv3N16overload_example1C1fEd"></span><span id="_CPPv2N16overload_example1C1fEd"></span><span id="overload_example::C::f__double"></span><span class="kt"><span class="pre">void</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">f</span></span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><span class="kt"><span class="pre">double</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n sig-param"><span class="pre">d</span></span><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="headerlink" href="#_CPPv4N16overload_example1C1fEd" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a><br /></dt>

+<p>References using the <a class="reference internal" href="#role-cpp-func" title="cpp:func role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cpp:func</span></code></a> role:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p>Arbitrary overload: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">C::f</span></code>, <a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4NK16overload_example1C1fEd" title="overload_example::C::f"><code class="xref cpp cpp-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">C::f()</span></code></a></p></li>

+<li><p>Specific overload: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f()</span></code>, <a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4N16overload_example1C1fEv" title="void C::f()"><code class="xref cpp cpp-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f()</span></code></a></p></li>
+<li><p>Specific overload: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f(int)</span></code>, <a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4N16overload_example1C1fEi" title="void C::f(int)"><code class="xref cpp cpp-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f(int)</span></code></a></p></li>
+<li><p>Specific overload: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f(double)</span></code>, <a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4N16overload_example1C1fEd" title="void C::f(double)"><code class="xref cpp cpp-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f(double)</span></code></a></p></li>
+<li><p>Specific overload: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f(double)</span> <span class="pre">const</span></code>,
+<a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4NK16overload_example1C1fEd" title="void C::f(double) const"><code class="xref cpp cpp-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">void</span> <span class="pre">C::f(double)</span> <span class="pre">const</span></code></a></p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>Note that the <a href="#id16"><span class="problematic" id="id17">:confval:`add_function_parentheses`</span></a> configuration variable

+<section id="templated-declarations">
+<h4>Templated declarations<a class="headerlink" href="#templated-declarations" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h4>
+<p>Assume the following declarations.</p>
+<dl class="cpp class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object cpp" id="_CPPv47Wrapper">
+<span id="_CPPv37Wrapper"></span><span id="_CPPv27Wrapper"></span><span id="Wrapper"></span><span class="k"><span class="pre">class</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">Wrapper</span></span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#_CPPv47Wrapper" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a><br /></dt>
+<dd><dl class="cpp class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object cpp" id="_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5OuterE">
+<span id="_CPPv3I0EN7Wrapper5OuterE"></span><span id="_CPPv2I0EN7Wrapper5OuterE"></span><span class="k"><span class="pre">template</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre"><</span></span><span class="k"><span class="pre">typename</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">TOuter</span></span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">></span></span><br /><span class="k"><span class="pre">class</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">Outer</span></span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5OuterE" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a><br /></dt>
+<dd><dl class="cpp class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object cpp" id="_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5Outer5InnerE">
+<span id="_CPPv3I0EN7Wrapper5Outer5InnerE"></span><span id="_CPPv2I0EN7Wrapper5Outer5InnerE"></span><span class="k"><span class="pre">template</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre"><</span></span><span class="k"><span class="pre">typename</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">TInner</span></span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">></span></span><br /><span class="k"><span class="pre">class</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">Inner</span></span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5Outer5InnerE" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a><br /></dt>
+<dd></dd></dl>
+
+</dd></dl>
+
+</dd></dl>
+
+<p>In general the reference must include the template parameter declarations,
+and template arguments for the prefix of qualified names. For example:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template\<typename</span> <span class="pre">TOuter></span> <span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer</span></code>
+(<a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5OuterE" title="Wrapper::Outer"><code class="xref cpp cpp-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template<typename</span> <span class="pre">TOuter></span> <span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer</span></code></a>)</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template\<typename</span> <span class="pre">TOuter></span> <span class="pre">template\<typename</span> <span class="pre">TInner></span> <span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer<TOuter>::Inner</span></code>
+(<code class="xref cpp cpp-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template<typename</span> <span class="pre">TOuter></span> <span class="pre">template<typename</span> <span class="pre">TInner></span> <span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer<TOuter>::Inner</span></code>)</p></li>
+</ul>
+<p>Currently the lookup only succeed if the template parameter identifiers are
+equal strings.  That is, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template\<typename</span> <span class="pre">UOuter></span> <span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer</span></code> will not
+work.</p>
+<p>As a shorthand notation, if a template parameter list is omitted,
+then the lookup will assume either a primary template or a non-template,
+but not a partial template specialisation.
+This means the following references work as well:</p>
+<ul class="simple">
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer</span></code>
+(<a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5OuterE" title="Wrapper::Outer"><code class="xref cpp cpp-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer</span></code></a>)</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer::Inner</span></code>
+(<a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5Outer5InnerE" title="Wrapper::Outer::Inner"><code class="xref cpp cpp-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer::Inner</span></code></a>)</p></li>
+<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template\<typename</span> <span class="pre">TInner></span> <span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer::Inner</span></code>
+(<a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4I0EN7Wrapper5Outer5InnerE" title="Wrapper::Outer::Inner"><code class="xref cpp cpp-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template<typename</span> <span class="pre">TInner></span> <span class="pre">Wrapper::Outer::Inner</span></code></a>)</p></li>
+</ul>
+</section>

+<dl class="cpp class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object cpp" id="_CPPv4I0E5OuterIP1TE">
+<span id="_CPPv3I0E5OuterIP1TE"></span><span id="_CPPv2I0E5OuterIP1TE"></span><span class="k"><span class="pre">template</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre"><</span></span><span class="k"><span class="pre">typename</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">T</span></span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">></span></span><br /><span class="k"><span class="pre">class</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="n"><span class="pre">Outer</span></span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre"><</span></span><a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4I0E5OuterIP1TE" title="Outer<T*>::T"><span class="n"><span class="pre">T</span></span></a><span class="p"><span class="pre">*</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">></span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#_CPPv4I0E5OuterIP1TE" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a><br /></dt>
+<dd></dd></dl>
+
+<p>References to partial specialisations must always include the template
+parameter lists, e.g., <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template\<typename</span> <span class="pre">T></span> <span class="pre">Outer\<T*></span></code>
+(<a class="reference internal" href="#_CPPv4I0E5OuterIP1TE" title="Outer<T*>"><code class="xref cpp cpp-class docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">template<typename</span> <span class="pre">T></span> <span class="pre">Outer<T*></span></code></a>).  Currently the lookup only
+succeed if the template parameter identifiers are equal strings.</p>
+</section>
+</section>
+<section id="id18">
+<h3>Configuration Variables<a class="headerlink" href="#id18" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h3>
+<p>See <a class="reference internal" href="../configuration.html#cpp-config"><span class="std std-ref">Options for the C++ domain</span></a>.</p>
+</section>
+</section>
+<section id="the-standard-domain">
+<span id="domains-std"></span><h2>The Standard Domain<a class="headerlink" href="#the-standard-domain" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>The so-called “standard” domain collects all markup that doesn’t warrant a
+domain of its own.  Its directives and roles are not prefixed with a domain
+name.</p>
+<p>The standard domain is also where custom object descriptions, added using the
+<a class="reference internal" href="../../extdev/appapi.html#sphinx.application.Sphinx.add_object_type" title="sphinx.application.Sphinx.add_object_type"><code class="xref py py-func docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">add_object_type()</span></code></a> API, are placed.</p>
+<p>There is a set of directives allowing documenting command-line programs:</p>
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-option">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">option::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span> <span class="pre">args,</span> <span class="pre">name</span> <span class="pre">args,</span> <span class="pre">...</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-option" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes a command line argument or switch.  Option argument names should
+be enclosed in angle brackets.  Examples:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">option</span><span class="p">::</span> dest_dir
+
+   Destination directory.
+
+<span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">option</span><span class="p">::</span> -m <module>, --module <module>
+
+   Run a module as a script.
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>The directive will create cross-reference targets for the given options,
+referenceable by <a class="reference internal" href="roles.html#role-option" title="option role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">option</span></code></a> (in the example case, you’d use something
+like <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:option:`dest_dir`</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:option:`-m`</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:option:`--module`</span></code>).</p>
+<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">cmdoption</span></code> directive is a deprecated alias for the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">option</span></code> directive.</p>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-envvar">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">envvar::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-envvar" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes an environment variable that the documented code or program uses
+or defines.  Referenceable by <a class="reference internal" href="roles.html#role-envvar" title="envvar role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">envvar</span></code></a>.</p>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-program">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">program::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-program" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Like <a class="reference internal" href="#directive-py-currentmodule" title="py:currentmodule directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">py:currentmodule</span></code></a>, this directive produces no output.
+Instead, it serves to notify Sphinx that all following <a class="reference internal" href="#directive-option" title="option directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">option</span></code></a>
+directives document options for the program called <em>name</em>.</p>
+<p>If you use <a class="reference internal" href="#directive-program" title="program directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">program</span></code></a>, you have to qualify the references in your
+<a class="reference internal" href="roles.html#role-option" title="option role"><code class="xref rst rst-role docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">option</span></code></a> roles by the program name, so if you have the following
+situation</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">program</span><span class="p">::</span> rm
+
+<span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">option</span><span class="p">::</span> -r
+
+   Work recursively.
+
+<span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">program</span><span class="p">::</span> svn
+
+<span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">option</span><span class="p">::</span> -r revision
+
+   Specify the revision to work upon.
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>then <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:option:`rm</span> <span class="pre">-r`</span></code> would refer to the first option, while
+<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:option:`svn</span> <span class="pre">-r`</span></code> would refer to the second one.</p>
+<p>If <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code> is passed to the argument, the directive will reset the
+current program name.</p>
+<p>The program name may contain spaces (in case you want to document
+subcommands like <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">svn</span> <span class="pre">add</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">svn</span> <span class="pre">commit</span></code> separately).</p>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 0.5.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<p>There is also a very generic object description directive, which is not tied to
+any domain:</p>
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-describe">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">describe::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">text</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-describe" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-object">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">object::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">text</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-object" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>This directive produces the same formatting as the specific ones provided by
+domains, but does not create index entries or cross-referencing targets.
+Example:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">describe</span><span class="p">::</span> PAPER
+
+   You can set this variable to select a paper size.
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</dd></dl>
+
+</section>
+<section id="the-javascript-domain">
+<h2>The JavaScript Domain<a class="headerlink" href="#the-javascript-domain" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>The JavaScript domain (name <strong>js</strong>) provides the following directives:</p>
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-js-module">
+<span id="directive-js:module"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">js:module::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-js-module" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>This directive sets the module name for object declarations that follow
+after. The module name is used in the global module index and in cross
+references. This directive does not create an object heading like
+<a class="reference internal" href="#directive-py-class" title="py:class directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">py:class</span></code></a> would, for example.</p>
+<p>By default, this directive will create a linkable entity and will cause an
+entry in the global module index, unless the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">noindex</span></code> option is
+specified.  If this option is specified, the directive will only update the
+current module name.</p>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 1.6.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-js-function">
+<span id="directive-js:function"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">js:function::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name(signature)</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-js-function" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes a JavaScript function or method.  If you want to describe
+arguments as optional use square brackets as <a class="reference internal" href="#signatures"><span class="std std-ref">documented</span></a>
+for Python signatures.</p>
+<p>You can use fields to give more details about arguments and their expected
+types, errors which may be thrown by the function, and the value being
+returned:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">js:function</span><span class="p">::</span> $.getJSON(href, callback[, errback])
+
+   <span class="nc">:param string href:</span> An URI to the location of the resource.
+   <span class="nc">:param callback:</span> Gets called with the object.
+   <span class="nc">:param errback:</span>
+       Gets called in case the request fails. And a lot of other
+       text so we need multiple lines.
+   <span class="nc">:throws SomeError:</span> For whatever reason in that case.
+   <span class="nc">:returns:</span> Something.
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>This is rendered as:</p>
+<blockquote>
+<div><dl class="js function">
+<dt class="sig sig-object js" id="getJSON">
+<span id="_S_.getJSON"></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"><span class="pre">$.</span></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">getJSON</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="pre">href</span></em>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="pre">callback</span></em><span class="optional">[</span>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="pre">errback</span></em><span class="optional">]</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="headerlink" href="#getJSON" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><dl class="field-list simple">
+<dt class="field-odd">Arguments</dt>
+<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
+<li><p><strong>href</strong> (<em>string</em>) – An URI to the location of the resource.</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>callback</strong> – Gets called with the object.</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>errback</strong> – Gets called in case the request fails. And a lot of other
+text so we need multiple lines.</p></li>
+</ul>
+</dd>
+<dt class="field-even">Throws</dt>
+<dd class="field-even"><p><strong>SomeError</strong> – For whatever reason in that case.</p>
+</dd>
+<dt class="field-odd">Returns</dt>
+<dd class="field-odd"><p>Something.</p>
+</dd>
+</dl>
+</dd></dl>
+
+</div></blockquote>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-js-method">
+<span id="directive-js:method"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">js:method::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name(signature)</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-js-method" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>This directive is an alias for <a class="reference internal" href="#directive-js-function" title="js:function directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">js:function</span></code></a>, however it describes
+a function that is implemented as a method on a class object.</p>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 1.6.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-js-class">
+<span id="directive-js:class"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">js:class::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-js-class" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes a constructor that creates an object.  This is basically like a
+function but will show up with a <cite>class</cite> prefix:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">js:class</span><span class="p">::</span> MyAnimal(name[, age])
+
+   <span class="nc">:param string name:</span> The name of the animal
+   <span class="nc">:param number age:</span> an optional age for the animal
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>This is rendered as:</p>
+<blockquote>
+<div><dl class="js class">
+<dt class="sig sig-object js" id="MyAnimal">
+<em class="property"><span class="pre">class</span> </em><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">MyAnimal</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span><em class="sig-param"><span class="pre">name</span></em><span class="optional">[</span>, <em class="sig-param"><span class="pre">age</span></em><span class="optional">]</span><span class="sig-paren">)</span><a class="headerlink" href="#MyAnimal" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><dl class="field-list simple">
+<dt class="field-odd">Arguments</dt>
+<dd class="field-odd"><ul class="simple">
+<li><p><strong>name</strong> (<em>string</em>) – The name of the animal</p></li>
+<li><p><strong>age</strong> (<em>number</em>) – an optional age for the animal</p></li>
+</ul>
+</dd>
+</dl>
+</dd></dl>
+
+</div></blockquote>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-js-data">
+<span id="directive-js:data"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">js:data::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-js-data" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes a global variable or constant.</p>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-js-attribute">
+<span id="directive-js:attribute"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">js:attribute::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">object.name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-js-attribute" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes the attribute <em>name</em> of <em>object</em>.</p>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<p id="js-roles">These roles are provided to refer to the described objects:</p>
+<dl class="rst role">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-js-mod">
+<span id="role-js:mod"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:js:mod:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-js-mod" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-js-func">
+<span id="role-js:func"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:js:func:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-js-func" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-js-meth">
+<span id="role-js:meth"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:js:meth:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-js-meth" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-js-class">
+<span id="role-js:class"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:js:class:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-js-class" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-js-data">
+<span id="role-js:data"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:js:data:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-js-data" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-js-attr">
+<span id="role-js:attr"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:js:attr:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-js-attr" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd></dd></dl>
+
+</section>
+<section id="the-restructuredtext-domain">
+<h2>The reStructuredText domain<a class="headerlink" href="#the-restructuredtext-domain" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>The reStructuredText domain (name <strong>rst</strong>) provides the following directives:</p>
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-rst-directive">
+<span id="directive-rst:directive"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">rst:directive::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-rst-directive" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes a reST directive.  The <em>name</em> can be a single directive name or
+actual directive syntax (<cite>..</cite> prefix and <cite>::</cite> suffix) with arguments that
+will be rendered differently.  For example:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">rst:directive</span><span class="p">::</span> foo
+
+   Foo description.
+
+<span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">rst:directive</span><span class="p">::</span> .. bar:: baz
+
+   Bar description.
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>will be rendered as:</p>
+<blockquote>
+<div><dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-foo">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">foo::</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-foo" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Foo description.</p>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-bar">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">bar::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">baz</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-bar" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Bar description.</p>
+</dd></dl>
+
+</div></blockquote>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-rst-directive-option">
+<span id="directive-rst:directive:option"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">rst:directive:option::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-rst-directive-option" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes an option for reST directive.  The <em>name</em> can be a single option
+name or option name with arguments which separated with colon (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">:</span></code>).
+For example:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">rst:directive</span><span class="p">::</span> toctree
+
+<span class="p">   ..</span> <span class="ow">rst:directive:option</span><span class="p">::</span> caption: caption of ToC
+
+<span class="p">   ..</span> <span class="ow">rst:directive:option</span><span class="p">::</span> glob
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>will be rendered as:</p>
+<blockquote>
+<div><dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">toctree::</span></span></dt>
+<dd><dl class="rst directive:option">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-option-toctree-caption">
+<span id="directive:option-toctree-caption"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:caption:</span></span><em class="property"> <span class="pre">caption</span> <span class="pre">of</span> <span class="pre">ToC</span></em><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-option-toctree-caption" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd></dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive:option">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-option-toctree-glob">
+<span id="directive:option-toctree-glob"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:glob:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-option-toctree-glob" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd></dd></dl>
+
+</dd></dl>
+
+</div></blockquote>
+<p class="rubric">options</p>
+<dl class="rst directive:option">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-option-rst-directive-option-type">
+<span id="directive:option-rst:directive:option-type"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:type:</span></span><em class="property"> <span class="pre">description</span> <span class="pre">of</span> <span class="pre">argument</span></em><em class="property"> <span class="pre">(text)</span></em><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-option-rst-directive-option-type" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describe the type of option value.</p>
+<p>For example:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">rst:directive</span><span class="p">::</span> toctree
+
+<span class="p">   ..</span> <span class="ow">rst:directive:option</span><span class="p">::</span> maxdepth
+      <span class="nc">:type:</span> integer or no value
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 2.1.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd></dl>
+
+</dd></dl>
+
+<dl class="rst directive">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="directive-rst-role">
+<span id="directive-rst:role"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">..</span> <span class="pre">rst:role::</span></span><span class="sig-prename descclassname"> <span class="pre">name</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#directive-rst-role" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Describes a reST role.  For example:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">rst:role</span><span class="p">::</span> foo
+
+   Foo description.
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>will be rendered as:</p>
+<blockquote>
+<div><dl class="rst role">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-foo">
+<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:foo:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-foo" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Foo description.</p>
+</dd></dl>
+
+</div></blockquote>
+</dd></dl>
+
+<p id="rst-roles">These roles are provided to refer to the described objects:</p>
+<dl class="rst role">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-rst-dir">
+<span id="role-rst:dir"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:rst:dir:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-rst-dir" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-rst-role">
+<span id="role-rst:role"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:rst:role:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-rst-role" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd></dd></dl>
+
+</section>
+<section id="the-math-domain">
+<span id="math-domain"></span><h2>The Math Domain<a class="headerlink" href="#the-math-domain" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>The math domain (name <strong>math</strong>) provides the following roles:</p>
+<dl class="rst role">
+<dt class="sig sig-object rst" id="role-math-numref">
+<span id="role-math:numref"></span><span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">:math:numref:</span></span><a class="headerlink" href="#role-math-numref" title="Permalink to this definition">¶</a></dt>
+<dd><p>Role for cross-referencing equations defined by <a class="reference internal" href="directives.html#directive-math" title="math directive"><code class="xref rst rst-dir docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">math</span></code></a> directive
+via their label.  Example:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">..</span> <span class="ow">math</span><span class="p">::</span> e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0
+   <span class="nc">:label:</span> euler
+
+Euler's identity, equation <span class="na">:math:numref:</span><span class="nv">`euler`</span>, was elected one of the
+most beautiful mathematical formulas.
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 1.8.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd></dl>
+
+</section>
+<section id="more-domains">
+<h2>More domains<a class="headerlink" href="#more-domains" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>The <a class="reference external" href="https://github.com/sphinx-contrib">sphinx-contrib</a> repository contains more domains available as extensions;

+domains. Also available are domains for <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinxcontrib-chapeldomain/">Chapel</a>, <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinxcontrib-cldomain/">Common Lisp</a>, <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinxcontrib-dqndomain/">dqn</a>, <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinxcontrib-golangdomain/">Go</a>,
+<a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinxcontrib-jinjadomain/">Jinja</a>, <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinxcontrib-operationdomain/">Operation</a>, and <a class="reference external" href="https://pypi.org/project/sphinxcontrib-scaladomain/">Scala</a>.</p>

+  <section id="field-lists">
+<h1>Field Lists<a class="headerlink" href="#field-lists" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h1>
+<p><a class="reference internal" href="basics.html#rst-field-lists"><span class="std std-ref">As previously discussed</span></a>, field lists are sequences of
+fields marked up like this:</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nc">:fieldname:</span> Field content
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<p>Sphinx extends standard docutils behavior for field lists and adds some extra
+functionality that is covered in this section.</p>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>The values of field lists will be parsed as
+strings. You cannot use Python collections such as lists or dictionaries.</p>
+</div>
+<section id="file-wide-metadata">
+<span id="metadata"></span><h2>File-wide metadata<a class="headerlink" href="#file-wide-metadata" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>A field list near the top of a file is normally parsed by docutils as the
+<em>docinfo</em> and shown on the page.  However, in Sphinx, a field list preceding
+any other markup is moved from the <em>docinfo</em> to the Sphinx environment as
+document metadata, and is not displayed in the output.</p>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>A field list appearing after the document title <em>will</em> be part of the
+<em>docinfo</em> as normal and will be displayed in the output.</p>
+</div>
+</section>
+<section id="special-metadata-fields">
+<h2>Special metadata fields<a class="headerlink" href="#special-metadata-fields" title="Permalink to this headline">¶</a></h2>
+<p>Sphinx provides custom behavior for bibliographic fields compared to docutils.</p>
+<p>At the moment, these metadata fields are recognized:</p>
+<dl>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tocdepth</span></code></dt><dd><p>The maximum depth for a table of contents of this file.</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nc">:tocdepth:</span> 2
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>This metadata effects to the depth of local toctree.  But it does not
+effect to the depth of <em>global</em> toctree.  So this would not be change
+the sidebar of some themes which uses global one.</p>
+</div>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 0.4.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">nocomments</span></code></dt><dd><p>If set, the web application won’t display a comment form for a page
+generated from this source file.</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nc">:nocomments:</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">orphan</span></code></dt><dd><p>If set, warnings about this file not being included in any toctree will be
+suppressed.</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nc">:orphan:</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 1.0.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd>
+<dt><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">nosearch</span></code></dt><dd><p>If set, full text search for this file is disabled.</p>
+<div class="highlight-rst notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nc">:nosearch:</span>
+</pre></div>
+</div>
+<div class="admonition note">
+<p class="admonition-title">Note</p>
+<p>object search is still available even if <cite>nosearch</cite> option is set.</p>
+</div>
+<div class="versionadded">
+<p><span class="versionmodified added">New in version 3.0.</span></p>
+</div>
+</dd>
